apps.name: JiivJiiv - Tulip Era and the Janissary Corps
apps.short_description: An Ottoman farm of the Tulip Era: a köşk coop, a serender granary, a palace kitchen and bird palace, tulip beds and a fountain, with Janissary and mehter outfits for your flock.

apps.name: Lorn's Lure - Parkour Map Pack
apps.short_description: Enjoy 4 diverse parkour challenges, as well as one experimental procedural level with a survival gameplay tinge.

apps.name: Mr. Prepper: Supporter Pack
apps.short_description: Prepare deeper into the world of Mr. Prepper with this exclusive Supporter Pack! Includes additional content for the base game.

apps.name: PIE PINBALL
apps.short_description: Fire up the ovens in **PIE PINBALL**, a fast, outrageous arcade table packed with spinners, bumpers, ramps, drop targets, kickbacks, rollovers and frantic multiball action!

apps.name: PINBALL FIREFIGHTERS ENGINE COMPANY NO. 77
apps.short_description: Answer the alarm and battle a city in flames in **Pinball Firefighters Engine Company No. 77**. Smash targets, race the ramps, hit spinners, trigger kickbacks, complete rollovers and unleash frantic multiball mayhem in a blazing 1930s firehouse spectacle.

apps.name: PRETZEL PINBALL
apps.short_description: 🥨 **PRETZEL PINBALL** is a wild Bavarian arcade blast packed with blazing ramps, bumpers, spinners, drop targets, kickbacks, rollovers and explosive **Pretzel Pandemonium Multiball!**

apps.name: SODA PINBALL
apps.short_description: Crack open the action in SODA PINBALL! Blast through ramps, bumpers, spinners, drop targets, kickbacks and rollovers, then unleash fizzy multiball mayhem in a neon-soaked 1950s soda shop.

apps.name: Supporter Pack
apps.short_description: THE ESCAPE ACADEMY 2 SUPPORTER PACK INCLUDES THE OFFICIAL ESCAPE ACADEMY 2 DIGITAL SOUNDTRACK + BEHIND-THE-SCENES DIGITAL ART BOOK.

apps.name: TACO PINBALL
apps.short_description: Fire up the grill and hit the road in **Taco Pinball**! Blast ramps, hammer drop targets, spin spinners, trigger kickbacks, light rollovers, smash bumpers and unleash wild **Fiesta Multiball** in a blazing 1990s-style arcade adventure.

apps.name: Tactical Assault VR - FBI Special Agent Pack
apps.short_description: EXPANDED FBI Inspired cosmetics

apps.name: Tactical Assault VR - Operation: Dahlia DLC
apps.short_description: The Operation: Dahlia DLC is an expansion pack containing 5 all new missions, a new multiplayer lobby/social hub (with basketball court and outdoor shooting range), new weapons, and an ample amount of new cosmetics dedicated to the LEO (Law Enforcement Officer)/SWAT theme.

apps.name: The Last of Us™ Part I - Upgrade to Digital Deluxe Edition
apps.short_description: Existing The Last of Us™ Part I Digital Standard Edition owners can upgrade to the Digital Deluxe Edition for an additional cost.

apps.name: The Pass - Hugely Regarded Pack
apps.short_description: Adults only. Adds explicit adult art for every character you own, toggled in-game with the NSFW Toggle, plus a 6x points multiplier on every roll. Sayaka's adult art also requires owning the Well Regarded Pack.

apps.name: Tom Clancy's Ghost Recon Wildlands - Ghost War Pass
apps.short_description:
Ghost War is the 4v4 Tactical PVP experience of Ghost Recon Wildlands. 
Ghost War Pass unlocks 6 additional post-launch classes for Ghost Recon Wildlands PvP mode.

apps.name: Walkabout Mini Golf - Alice's Adventure in Wonderland
apps.short_description: Follow the white rabbit and dive down into the curiouser and curiouser world of one of the most fantastical stories of all time. Shrink your worries, grow your imagination and explore the whimsical world of Wonderland to your heart’s content! After all, every adventure requires a first step.

apps.name: Wild Americas-Land Rush
apps.short_description: Land Rush adds persistent, fully destructible terrain you claim and hold with your militia. Get 7 days to build before the walls come down, then locate Helium-3 sources, extract them, and defend your P.L.O.T. against rival land owners in PvEvP.

apps.name: Your Mom - DLC
apps.short_description: Your mom is here, come quickly to play happily with your mom.

apps.name: 言葉遠征 - JLPT-地狱之旅
apps.short_description: Take on tough N2 and N1 Japanese trials with Elle and Izayoi. Answer questions to Attack, Guard, and Heal as you purify 37 buildings and face Enma. Nearly 1,900 questions, 20 question types, 444 lore passages, and exclusive gear, titles, and crests await.

apps.name: 10 Minutes to Make a Million
apps.short_description:
You have 10 minutes to make $1,000,000. 

Pick a character, draft three businesses, then hustle, invest or gamble your way there before the timer hits zero. A roguelike economy game where the playstyle is yours and the clock is not.

apps.name: 20 Floors Down
apps.short_description: Forced to descend a dark dungeon of endless horrors, you must get to the bottom to escape your torment. 20 Floors Down is a brutal top-down horror roguelite where you must manage items, manage upgrades, and survive relentless monsters in the dark. And remember... DO NOT let your light run out.

apps.name: 41号の冒険
apps.short_description:
An organic android, Unit No.41—nicknamed Yoi—warps to another world in search of “Hebdomas”, a substance capable of eliminating the Saima.
A short fantasy RPG that follows the traces of memories left behind in a world where humanity has already fallen.

apps.name: 911 With Your Friends
apps.short_description: A co-op chaos comedy for 1 to 8 friends. Work the night shift at a fictional city's dispatch center, talk to AI callers out loud, sort real emergencies from pranks, send the right units and coach callers until help arrives. Then go wreck the break room.

apps.name: A Game About Games
apps.short_description: The cosy video game stacking sim. Sort the chaos and race the clock! Grab and hurl game cases onto shelves, then upgrade your speed, reach, and throw. Can you conquer small, medium, large, and totally randomised procedural store layouts?

apps.name: A Maize in Mazes
apps.short_description: A first-person party race through glass mazes. The goal is always in sight. Grab items to save yourself or sabotage earone else.

apps.name: A Risky Rocky Resort
apps.short_description: Run a luxurious resort during the day and cater to your guests’ needs in order to make the big bucks! But be wary, because at night, pirates and other invaders show up! Entertain, build, and survive, and hopefully, you’ll make it big!

apps.name: A Sweet Date With Gardenia
apps.short_description: Embark on a sensual honeybee-hunting adventure with Gardenia, an attractive young woman. In this hidden object game, explore each location to discover what lies beneath Gardenia's enticing layers.

apps.name: A Taste of Success
apps.short_description: A five-course meal, painstaking prepared.  In this fully voiced visual novel, you play as Reynard Russet.  As an up-and-coming chef, can you balance your career and family?  Or will you sacrifice everything to reach the pinnacle of culinary success?

apps.name: A Thousand Stamps
apps.short_description: Collect, sort, and organize hundreds of unique stamps across beautiful themed albums. Play alone or online with friends, create your own collections from photos, and enjoy the simple pleasure of putting everything in its place.

apps.name: A to Zen: Cozy Anime Puzzle
apps.short_description: A cozy anime picture puzzle. Piece together 32 hand-finished illustrations with gentle sliding and jigsaw puzzles, collect the whole alphabet from A to Z, and keep every artwork as a wallpaper. Warm music, no timers, no pressure.

apps.name: Above: Colonies of the Mist
apps.short_description: Build a hilltop colony in the last land safe from the toxic mist. Survive, expand, explore ancient monuments, and look for a way out before the mist claims everything.

apps.name: Age Breaker
apps.short_description: Mine gold, train an army and evolve your fortress from bone clubs to plasma blades in this one-lane strategy game. Lead four peoples and eight Leaders through a 36-battle campaign with boss fights, or set up your own skirmish on six maps.

apps.name: ALife: Becoming
apps.short_description: A sci-fi exploration and automation sandbox: walk tiny planets, gather and haul resources, raise bridges between worlds, and train Sparks by recording the trails they learn to follow. Show the path, don't script it, in a physical world that stays surprising.

apps.name: All You Can Love: Hotel Paradiso
apps.short_description: Leave your worries at reception. Tom’s romantic getaway has become a holiday for one. Explore a sunny seaside hotel with more charm than stars, solve puzzles and flirt your way into trouble in a classic point-and-click comedy. The women of Hotel Paradiso have plans of their own.

apps.name: Anvil United!
apps.short_description: A wacky co-op strategy for up to 4 players where every level is a new crafting challenge and a randomized reward opportunity.

apps.name: Anvilborn
apps.short_description: Mine ore, forge gear in many rarity tiers and send your hero through ever more dangerous zones into the endless depths. A calm crafting idle game with research, orders, companions and gems – it keeps working while you're away.

apps.name: APART
apps.short_description: APART™ Is a third-person adventure game that follows an undead child with a severed arm companion whose bond seems to defy death. Survive and explore a world plunged into darkness after a tech breakthrough turns biological remains into humanity’s most valuable energy source.

apps.name: Apocalypticlick
apps.short_description: The world ended. Somebody still has to sort the scrap. Found a settlement, gather resources, and try to keep the roof on while the wasteland keeps knocking. An idle survival builder with research, expeditions, events, raids, and consequences.

apps.name: Apothecary Grounds
apps.short_description: Explore a seemingly empty land where a lonely graveyard is your only familiar landmark. Gather the items needed to unlock a sealed crypt, uncover the secrets beyond its door, evade the relentless Apothecary who guards the grounds, and unravel the mystery buried beneath them.

apps.name: Arcadian Invasion
apps.short_description: The bullet-dodging, commander-hiring, combo-building arcade roguelite. Fill your ship with auto-firing commanders and rule-breaking upgrades between waves, survive the alien armada, and crush bosses that each remix a classic arcade game.

apps.name: Archa
apps.short_description: Archa is a 2D platformer all about movement, combat, exploration, and score! To complete a level, you must gather a certain amount of points, and find the exit. Points are given by collecting and attacking enemies.

apps.name: ArcMages
apps.short_description: Choose your spellbook and blast your rivals off the map in turn-based online artillery battles. Hurl fireballs, call down meteors, summon dragons, and carve the destructible battlefield into fortresses or craters. One turn, one spell, one perfect shot.

apps.name: Aw Hell: An Oh Hell Card Game
apps.short_description: The bar's back room, seven chairs, and a deck of cards. Aw Hell is the trick-taking game of calling your shot: bid exactly how many tricks you'll win, then take that many and not one more. Play friends online, the house bots offline, or ranked for a rating.

apps.name: Backrooms Anomaly: Pools
apps.short_description: An anomaly-spotting horror game set in looping liminal poolrooms. Study your surroundings and identify changes ranging from subtle details to terrifying entities. Turn back if something has changed, continue if everything seems normal, and then use your camera to document the anomalies.

apps.name: Banshee Bash
apps.short_description: Banshee Bash is a local-multiplayer party game. Fight with up to 3 friends (or add bots) to battle as a team, or in an epic free-for-all. Stack spell books to create unbalanced chaos and grab potion bottles to stay in the fight.

apps.name: Battle Refrain
apps.short_description: “Battle Refrain” is a co-op boss rush for up to four players. Four people swallowed by a labyrinth must defeat the giant bosses beyond its doors to escape. Read their devastating attacks, leap clear and slash into openings. Choose your next door together and help fallen allies to their feet.

apps.name: Below the Ashes
apps.short_description: Forty years after the sky caught fire, your group goes underground to survive. Lead a crew, dig into a world of cave-ins, floods and darkness, and face what is climbing up from the deep. Alone or in online co-op with up to 8 players.

apps.name: Between Two Midnights
apps.short_description: Experience a story of temptation, passion, and emotional discovery as Adrian navigates tangled secrets, rising jealousy, and intense romance to decide where his heart truly belongs when the night finally ends.

apps.name: Beyond the Mortal Gate
apps.short_description: A story-driven xianxia RPG with a built-in local LLM. Talk to AI villagers in your own words—ask around, borrow gear, commission work, or pass word through friends. Villagers act only on what they witness or hear, turning your words and deeds into evolving rumors, favors, and consequences.

apps.name: Billionth Soul
apps.short_description: Grow humanity’s last colony from one thawed sleeper to one billion souls aboard a failing generation ship. Draft cards, build powerful grid combinations, and trade population against dwindling life support in this idle roguelite deckbuilder.  The billionth soul is the hardest one to save.

apps.name: Black Pine: Incident Response
apps.short_description: In 1980, the anomalous “Katabasis” event upset humanity’s control of Earth. Five years later, its remnants fight to stay alive, and you find yourself in Appalachia’s Blair County Exclusion Zone. Survive alone or in a group of up to six in this first-person co-op survival RPG.

apps.name: BLACKBOX-market poker-
apps.short_description: BLACKBOX blends poker strategy with market trading in a high-stakes simulation. Build powerful hands, make calculated trades, and manage risk as every card combination influences your profits and losses. Chase big gains—but one decision can change everything.

apps.name: Blades & Trades
apps.short_description: Forge your legacy as both merchant and hero. Explore Zoldar, battle monsters for rare materials, and craft epic gear. Team up with friends to build a thriving shop in the village markets or arm yourselves to conquer the dangerous depths of the wild.

apps.name: Blamcon's Light Gun Arcade
apps.short_description: You're own classic Arcade built for PC Light Guns and mouse. Destroy space debris, protect your city from an attack, take out an alien horde from below, break gems with your rail gun, fly solo breaking defenses over an alien world, fight though an alien world, and protect earth in your straighter.

apps.name: Blamcon's Light Gun Madness
apps.short_description: Light Gun Madness is a travelling shooting show for your PC Light Guns. Test your skills, play with friends. A great party game. Use one light gun and pass it around to see who gets the best scores or play head to head with 2~4 light guns at the same time. You can use a mouse but it's not the same.

apps.name: Bloodrights
apps.short_description: An unknown disease has wiped out half of the city's population. The main characters managed to survive the outbreak. However, it's not as if everything went without consequences

apps.name: Blubber
apps.short_description: A turn-based sliding puzzle game about a very hungry seal. Push off and glide across the ice until something stops you, bounce off posts, ride ramps and eat fish along the way; every move costs food. Battle bosses, tackle 500+ levels, build your own, and play party games with friends.

apps.name: BodgeBall
apps.short_description: Multiplayer dodgeball that blends FPS intensity with ridiculous chaos. Hit opponents with balls or knock them offstage to send them to the bench, then catch a ball to bring teammates back into the fight.

apps.name: Bone - عظمة
apps.short_description: A 4-player co-op game where skeletons escort a fragile orb on a wagon.

apps.name: Bottle King
apps.short_description: From collecting bottles in the city park to founding the Cosmic Deposit Council: gather empties, hire helpers and grow a recycling empire that stretches from a small town to the edge of the universe. A relaxed pixel-art idle game that keeps running on the side.

apps.name: Breadventure
apps.short_description: A lore rich, party-based RPG about the loaf who became a legend - Collect delicious companions, then fight, cook, and schmooze your way to the top of Hester's HQ. Features multiple endings and a diverse assortment of eggs.

apps.name: Breeder Protocol
apps.short_description: Drop into a living alien hive with up to three friends. Reach the stranded crew before the breeders do, bring the uplinks online and fight your way to extraction. A twin-stick co-op roguelite where every hive is new and every run builds a deadlier squad.

apps.name: Bros Survivors
apps.short_description: Two players, one body, absolute chaos. Survive enemy hordes in this co-op Survivors-like. Merge with a friend into a giant mech: one controls horizontal movement, the other vertical. Will you coordinate or die trying?

apps.name: Burgerama Anomaly
apps.short_description: Serve or die in a late-night pedestrian underpass kiosk. Prepare different burgers, fry ingredients, and manage your supplies - all while inspecting your customers for inhuman traits. Follow the night's rules, survive various hazards, and uncover the truth behind the mutations.

apps.name: BUZZ or DIE
apps.short_description: The rules are simple. Dive into your opponent's mindscape and search for secrets. Turn those secrets into content and make a short video. Gain the most Likes from the audience to win.

apps.name: Camping Resort Simulator
apps.short_description: Build and run your own campsite in this cozy management sim. Turn an empty stretch of coast into a camping resort with a character all its own: lay out paths, place pitches, glamping and bungalows, shape the landscape, and welcome guests who each live their own little holiday.

apps.name: Candy Diggers
apps.short_description: Drill through candy planets, catch sweet critters and fuse upgrades into wild synergies in this cheerful digging roguelite. Every run brings candy home to your factory town, where belts and buildings turn it into coins for bigger, deeper runs. Save the candy universe from the Evil Veggie Council!

apps.name: Canyon Torque
apps.short_description: Build, armor and arm your ride for a 50 km trip through a zombie-infested canyon. Refuel, hunt, cook and survive the night. Discover 18 vehicles, tow cargo or your bike, and compete in circuit races, drag tournaments, Enduro and the launcher.

apps.name: Card Train
apps.short_description: Card Train is a retro pixel-art strategy card game for 2–4 players. Play from your hand, match cards in the shared train, and choose when to collect. Challenge AI or Steam friends online, customize decks and matching rules, and turn luck into thrilling comebacks!

apps.name: Castle Come
apps.short_description: Castle Come is a mecha builder and survival action game. Scout a strange land full of bandits in search of new parts, defeat enemy castles and loot the wreckage, recruit crew to man your growing arsenal of weapons and build your way from an agile fortling into a hulking, monster machine.

apps.name: Castle of the Winds
apps.short_description: Castle of the Winds is a classic early Windows roguelike. Set in a world inspired by Norse mythology, players explore procedurally generated dungeons beneath a quiet village, battling monsters, discovering magical items, and unraveling the mystery of an ancient evil.

apps.name: Catch Meow If You Can
apps.short_description:
An online co-op survival game for up to 4 players.
Play as a famous, award-winning cat. While the owner is away, different types of burglars invade the mansion. Explore dark rooms, solve puzzles, outsmart intruders, fight back, and escape without getting caught.

apps.name: Catch the Button
apps.short_description: A chaotic reaction game where every single click counts! Chase the moving button, build insane streaks, survive unpredictable events and watch out for tricks. Think you're fast enough to catch it?

apps.name: Cellsssss
apps.short_description: Build a viral army and clash with human cells in a large-scale strategy auto battler. Combine infantry, ranged units and cavalry, plan your deployment, and set each legion’s stance. Earn DNA through battle and expand your research tree to evolve your swarm.

apps.name: Cheesty
apps.short_description:
In a world built for humans, you'll have to evade scientists, solve puzzles and use your sense of smell to find your way in this adventure about freedom, belonging and home.

You play as Brie, a daring lab rat in search of the rodent paradise… Cheesty.

apps.name: ChimpUP!
apps.short_description:
ChimpUP! is a chaotic movement focused co-op party game where you and your friends battle, race and swing fast.
Armed with two independent grapple hooks for arms, swing around in a chaotic surreal world. Master the movement, sabotage your friends, race to the top, create cosmetics and maps.

apps.name: Chisel Me This
apps.short_description: Chisel Me This is a 1-8 player party game where you and your friends compete to create statues of various prompts. Sculpt large marble blocks, mold clay, and sabotage competitors as you create artistic masterpieces!

apps.name: Choppy Waters
apps.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder where you build your cards, not just your deck. Combine ingredients, each with its own effect, into sushi, then serve it to hungry pirates in turn-based battles. Spend gold to grow stronger, but run out and your voyage is over.

apps.name: CLAM
apps.short_description: Clam is an odd pet rat; googly-eyed, unpredictable and hyper-vigilant. One night she gets curious with the front door of the rat mansion and escapes with no way back in. Now she’s a tenant. Is the sharehouse as hospitable as home? Is the bond refundable? Find your way, tell your friends - it’s CLAM!

apps.name: Cluttermancer: Tidy Up the Nightmare Alley
apps.short_description: A cozy first-person tidying sim set in a bustling alley: 5 magical shops and 6,666 items to sort. Every shop on this street is chaos, every shelf has a rule, and every misplaced wand is your problem now.

apps.name: Code Red RTS
apps.short_description: A free Cold War real-time strategy game in full 3D. Build a base, mine ore and lead the Allies or the Soviets across 16 maps. Fight the computer, battle friends with up to eight players, or climb the ranked 1v1 and 2v2 ladders.

apps.name: Codys Collectathon
apps.short_description: Collect every item, dodge hazards and reach the portal before Cody runs out of oxygen. Explore 21 single-screen caverns in 8-bit or 16-bit graphics. Play the main campaign for free, with optional paid DLC for extra modes, the Level Editor and community-pack features.

apps.name: Coin Pusher Millionaire
apps.short_description: Spin the slots, fill your coin pusher with prizes, and push your way to a million! Buy upgrades, unlock higher tiers with bigger rewards, and complete collections in this satisfying coin pusher game.

apps.name: Complete Horror
apps.short_description: This is a horror survival game.Join the female protagonist to explore an abandoned subway station full of mysteries, seeking escape in oppressive darkness. Balance exploration, puzzles, and combat—one mistake may plunge you into endless abyss. Arm yourself constantly to face terrors from the depths.

apps.name: Confiscated!
apps.short_description: Your phone has been confiscated. So has everyone's stuff. It's all locked in the caretaker's office, and he's still in the building. A short first-person comedy-horror chase through a British primary school: sneak, distract, and leg it before the bell.

apps.name: Conglomerate
apps.short_description: One Earth, millions of cities, competing companies. Conglomerate is an economic simulation where every city is a moving part and every company is part of a shared global economy. Build supply chains, hire local workers and expand city by city.

apps.name: Cosmic Seance
apps.short_description: A cosmic detective game. Summon old gods, interpret visions, and trade your sanity for the truth. Unravel the enigma before madness takes you.

apps.name: Count My Coins, Coin Counter!
apps.short_description: Count coins with a cast of silly characters as you add up currencies, convert their money, appraise jewels, and pick out forgeries.

apps.name: Cozy Witch Store
apps.short_description: Cozy Witch Store is a first person organizing simulator. Help Selene the witch to sort potions, chests, grimoires and other magical objects after a little incident. Tidy up the store, earn coins and upgrade your skills.

apps.name: Crazy Road Shop Wars
apps.short_description: Run your own shop, compete against rival store owners, and sabotage the competition in this chaotic online multiplayer shop management game. Stock shelves, set prices, unlock new products, and do whatever it takes to become the ultimate retail king.

apps.name: Crimson Oathfall
apps.short_description: Build a monster that fights your way. Tear through swarms in a dark fantasy action roguelite, fuse mutations and graft organs from fallen guardians. Return to the refuge, unlock new forms and venture out to bring its missing people home.

apps.name: Crimson Princess
apps.short_description:
Beat 'em up(Belt Scroll) Action Game.
Control princesses with distinct fighting styles—one-handed sword, brawler, musket, greatsword, and hammer. Chain switches that shift range and tempo with support attacks to keep the pressure on.

apps.name: CruiserOrder
apps.short_description: Restore order to a cruise ship off Benidorm. Pick up 4,300 products, complete 64 objectives across 16 shops and solve preparation tasks. Upgrade your abilities, discover hidden souvenirs and play at your own pace in this single-player organizing game.

apps.name: Crytter Crawlers
apps.short_description: Crytter Crawlers is a 2.5d Creature-Collecting Bullet-Heaven Deckbuilding Roguelike where YOU play as Cryptids! Find dozens of Crytters! GROW your Crytters into several stronger forms, earn new weapons, discover new upgrades, and fight back against a multitude of post-apocalyptic threats!

apps.name: CyberIdle
apps.short_description: Run, fight and grow stronger in CyberIdle, a pixel-art idle RPG. Collect coins and monster drops, unlock upgrades, craft gear from blueprints and shape your build with equipment bonuses. Let combat run automatically or tap to attack faster.

apps.name: Danganronpa 2x2
apps.short_description: While on a school trip to Jabberwock Island, students are ensnared in Monokuma’s deadly game, forced into mutual killing and Class Trials to expose the culprit. Break through contradictions with high-speed detective action. Includes both a brand-new scenario and the enhanced original!

apps.name: Dark Hours: Anomalies
apps.short_description: Dark Hours: Anomalies is a 1-4 player co-op horror game. The Trickster has trapped your crew of thieves in an endless loop. Memorize every room and spot the anomalies to break the curse. Miss one and you start over. Can you beat it, or will you be trapped forever?

apps.name: DARKDRAW
apps.short_description: Descend into the Abyss with a fading torch. Darkdraw is a roguelike deckbuilder where every battle is fought on a board, creature against creature, and the dying light changes the rules. Pick your clan, build your deck, keep your flame alive.

apps.name: Darkest Path
apps.short_description: Darkest Path is a 2.5D roguelike FPS that merges a modern-retro aesthetic with cosmic horror. Navigate through shifting nightmare realms, master diverse character classes, and survive the brutal corruption of a decaying world.

apps.name: Day 5
apps.short_description: It's Friday. The weekend is finally within reach. But when the same day begins to repeat, something is clearly wrong. Observe your surroundings, uncover the anomalies, and find a way to escape the loop in DAY 5, a third-person psychological horror game.

apps.name: DEADEYE
apps.short_description: Sail, fight, plunder, build! Start with a cutlass and a leaky raft, then crew a real ship, sink the navy, hunt sea monsters and claim an island of your own. The sea is shared, and nothing on it is safe.

apps.name: Dearest Darling Dragon
apps.short_description: Raise your own baby dragon and date a hot dragon "daddy" in this silly and fantastical stat-raiser dating sim! 🥚🐉

apps.name: Delved Too Deep
apps.short_description: Delved Too Deep is a game about an endless stream of machines exploring the depths seeking to fulfil the Factory Imperative. Each new machine iteration is better than the last, their accumulated knowledge leading to revelations that may change the fate of those who wander the deep...

apps.name: Demon Slayer Rome
apps.short_description: A dark fantasy turn-based RPG. Battle demons and absorb their abilities, uncover secrets and progress in power, and save an Empire lost to sin as you go up against eight demon princes and the hordes of Hades! Demon Slayer Rome is turn-based Mega Man set in the time of the Roman Empire.

apps.name: Destroyed Aperture
apps.short_description: Destroyed Aperture is a free community-made Portal 2 mod featuring a new full-blown campaign with 20+ levels of exploration and logic-based puzzles. Journey through a decaying Aperture facility, discover new testing elements, and uncover the truth buried in your forgotten past.

apps.name: Devil May Cry 3: Special Edition
apps.short_description: Dante's past is now revealed as Devil May Cry returns to its roots.  Master Dante's multiple fighting styles while battling never before seen demons and new characters as you fight your way towards a brutal confrontation with Dante's mysterious twin brother, Vergil.

apps.name: DEVOUT
apps.short_description: In a world where angels and Heaven are real, a grieving young man seeks to witness them in order to be reunited with his deceased wife. Pray, explore, and suffer in the name of your devotion as you quell dangers and make your way to the visitation site.

apps.name: Die or Die
apps.short_description: Roll the dice and choose how you will die. Die or Die is a top-down shooter roguelite where you run, shoot and dodge enemies to get dice with which to disable threats or unlock abilities. Roll. Die. Repeat.

apps.name: Dig into the Orefields
apps.short_description: A top-down action shooter with persistent incremental progression. Mine Venia's materials, fight the Klapperiden, upgrade your mining ship, and rebuild your crashed mothership piece by piece to escape the planet.

apps.name: Digging Up
apps.short_description: Digging Up is a 1-4 player co-op digging adventure where you drill through a destructible alien planet, gather valuable resources, upgrade your gear, explore underground biomes, and dig your way back to the surface.

apps.name: DJ Little Rabbit and the Battle of the Beatz!
apps.short_description: DJ Little Rabbit and the Battle of the Beatz is an all-ages adventure blending high-energy rhythm-action gameplay with heartfelt RPG storytelling. Join Little Rabbit’s journey to win the ‘Battle of the Beatz,’ become a legendary DJ, and reclaim his family’s lost honor.

apps.name: Do You Know Me?
apps.short_description: How well do you REALLY know your friends? Answer questions about each other alone in soundproof booths, vote on who’s most likely to do something stupid, then survive chaotic co-op challenges. 1-8 players.

apps.name: Don't Drop It
apps.short_description: Carry a fragile power core to its socket with a friend, and don't drop it! Whoever holds it can't jump: throw, catch and keep passing. Swinging cranes, steam jets and crumbling floors stand in your way.

apps.name: DreeM Ascension
apps.short_description: Explore the DreeMScape Darklands and uncover it's dark secrets in this story-driven survival horror boomer shooter.

apps.name: Drop That Pen
apps.short_description: Drop your pen through cursed pegs, bounce it into the cauldrons below, and upgrade your board between rounds in this hand-drawn, slightly haunted roguelite pachinko.

apps.name: Drudgemark
apps.short_description: The dark marches on the King's Realm and you stand at its border. Forge steel, build up your keep and command your soldiers in formation. Then draw your own blade and fight beside them in first person, alone or with your friends in co-op.

apps.name: Duck Casino: Gambling Simulator
apps.short_description: Bet big with fake money, losing never hurts! 12 casino games in one: Dice, Plinko, Mines, Blackjack, Roulette, Slots, Crash and more. Go all-in with a million? Sure. Broke? Top up with more fake cash and keep playing.

apps.name: Dulat
apps.short_description: Dulat is a puzzle-platformer where you manipulate how you interact with matter to overcome obstacles and restart the universe. Embark on this adventure, unravel its mysteries, and discover the secrets behind a broken world.

apps.name: Dumpster Gang
apps.short_description: Play as a gang of mischievous raccoons in this chaotic co-op sandbox for 1-4 players. Complete ridiculous missions, steal everything you can carry, and outsmart a relentless Exterminator determined to throw your gang behind bars.

apps.name: Dungeon Dreams Wanderers
apps.short_description: Travel, form bonds, explore a vast world filled with multiple-outcome quests, with your custom created protagonist in an adventure that blends old school JRPG, life simulation and role playing.

apps.name: Dungeonhand
apps.short_description: A single-player horror game about being hunted while you work. The contractors have given you ten nights to dig your debt out of an ancient dungeon. Everything you are carrying is lost when you die, and every death costs you one of the nights.

apps.name: DuoFall
apps.short_description: Pieces fall from the top and rise from the bottom - and you play both fields at once. Can you do it? Longer than your friends? Challenge them: same seed, live duel or leaderboard - every run is proven by replay. One mind. Two fields. Many blocks.

apps.name: DwarVein
apps.short_description: Welcome to DwarVein, a world where you a trusty dwarf venture forth into inhabited caves on the search for valuable Gems. Careful though, there are creatures lurking in the dark abyss. They have stolen your trusted companions and hid them within the caves! Will you achieve the highest score!?

apps.name: DYFWAS: Destroy Your Friends With Awesome Stuff
apps.short_description: Shoot, jump and smash your friends to pieces in arenas where anything can happen. Stack a wild variety of bonuses and build the playstyle that suits you, from brutal to twisted. 2–6 players: online, local with friends, or co-op against monsters.

apps.name: Dystopia VS Distortion
apps.short_description:
Build the ultimate pedalboard and crush despair with your sound!
A single-player pedalboard-building battle game. Rearrange your pedals to transform your tone and fight with a sound of your own.

apps.name: Echos of Eras
apps.short_description: Time broke, and you've been thrown back to the dawn of history. Cross the ages, from the Stone Age to the dinosaurs, and bond with the Echoes of each era. You don't catch them: win a turn-based battle and they may choose to follow you. A pixel-art creature RPG.

apps.name: Edenfall
apps.short_description: Unveil a mystical action-adventure where you shift between human, wolf, raccoon, and raven. Weave fluid combos across forms, purge corruption, and awaken the land’s lost beauty. Together with your spirit fox companion, embark on a soulbound journey of transformation, memory, and inner peace.

apps.name: Eletta
apps.short_description: Eletta is a mischievous action-adventure where you turn the environment into a weapon, setting up clever and chaotic traps to outwit enemies in ways that are equal parts hilarious and slightly devious.

apps.name: Epica Primera
apps.short_description: Turn-based JRPG. Guide a group of cute girls through the forest and try to survive the horrors lurking inside using a language-based syntax spell system.

apps.name: Epoch Extinction
apps.short_description: A tense top-down survival shooter where dinosaurs overrun abandoned towns and forests. Scavenge resources, craft tools, and make hard decisions while deadly predators hunt you through familiar human spaces.

apps.name: Eras Showdown
apps.short_description: An auto-battler where the shop doesn't sell a single weapon. It sells materials — Stone Age to far future — and you forge the rest. Line up eight units, gear them, and send them against the saved formations of real players. Ten wins take the run. Ten losses end it.

apps.name: EtheriiA - Travelogue
apps.short_description: Etheriia - Travelogue is an adult visual novel where players set off on a sensual journey across different universes, from sci-fi to medieval to elven, fixing visual glitches and restoring order.

apps.name: Event Horizon Inc.
apps.short_description: A co-op space salvage game at the edge of a black hole. You and up to 3 friends fly a small tug down, cut loot out of wrecked ships and haul it home. But time runs slower down there: every minute you stay costs the big ship waiting above hours, and it won't wait forever.

apps.name: EVERHOLD
apps.short_description: EVERHOLD is a fast-paced isometric survival game where you face increasingly dangerous enemies and powerful bosses. Choose your character, level up, collect powerful weapons and items, and fight your way to the end.

apps.name: Extracto Proviso
apps.short_description: Sent to a distant planet to feed a war you never chose, you are the perfect extraction machine. Build sprawling automated factories, survive a wilderness that fights back, and uncover whispers in the soil that make you question your directive. Extract everything. Then decide who it's for.

apps.name: Eyes on Me
apps.short_description: Play Ashley as she becomes an adult influencer discovers her sexuality and see just how far you will go to please others. Will you stay an innocent fashion student or transform into an adult star

apps.name: FACTORIZE: 1
apps.short_description: 2 attacks. 3 defends. 5 heals. Combine cards to create numbers and fight with the power of primes in this turn-based deckbuilding roguelite. Factorization is automatic—read the enemy, build the number you need, and find your own answer from the same hand.

apps.name: Fairwind
apps.short_description: FAIRWIND is a relaxing open-world sailing game about delivering cargo to distant ports. Deliver cargo, trade with merchants, upgrade your ship and discover new islands as you build trade routes across a vast archipelago. Play alone or with friends in 4-player co-op!

apps.name: FAKE ME
apps.short_description: Model, paint, and blend in! FAKE ME is an online multiplayer hide-and-seek game where you create your own disguise. Use simple 3D modeling tools to build the object you’ll hide as. You can also create your own costume by modeling. Hide from the Seekers or find every Faker before time runs out!

apps.name: False Fortune
apps.short_description: False Fortune is a modern crime RPG where you investigate the conspiracy that framed you, rebuild your fortune, buy businesses and homes, find love, marry, take honeymoons and vacations in a living, breathing world, and shape Adrian Vale’s future through evidence, leverage, redemption, or revenge.

apps.name: Fetch()
apps.short_description: Fetch() is a top-down territory game where you never touch the controls. Write a Lua script and your dog does exactly what it says, which is occasionally what you meant. Mark more tiles than the other packs before the clock runs out and the ground is yours.

apps.name: FGTeeV Goozy
apps.short_description: Explore a house full of weird technology and slimy surprises as you attempt to save the FGTeeV family.

apps.name: FILE 13
apps.short_description: A psychological horror game played entirely on a fake Egyptian desktop. Recover deleted files, read the metadata and follow the clues to find a woman missing for 14 months. Every answer pulls you deeper. Helping her is the mistake.

apps.name: Finders, Keepers
apps.short_description: Night work at St. Ossian's: go down into crypts that never end, carry up cursed and blessed relics, and sell them to the Keeper. Every curse pays better and frays your nerve. Die below and your haul stays down there with you, waiting for you to come back for it.

apps.name: Firezone S.A.
apps.short_description: Explore a massive open world across iconic global cities. Drive, build businesses, take on missions, evade the law, grow your influence, and choose your path through crime, ambition, wealth, and power.

apps.name: Fishing Shop Simulator
apps.short_description: Catch fish, build your store, and sell your catches!  Explore a mysterious world to find new areas, and new fish to catch.  Decorate to get wealthier customers to buy your big catches.  As you build up your store, a town will evolve around you!

apps.name: Flume
apps.short_description: A pixel-art puzzle roguelike where every run is different. Flip tiles, swap cards from your hand and build a route to the finish before the flow catches up.

apps.name: FRAY
apps.short_description: Fray is an intense hack-and-slash arena fighter where warriors from five ancient civilizations—Aztecs, Egyptians, Greeks, Japanese, and Vikings—battle for supremacy. Spawn with nothing, fight for weapons, and master fluid combat to claim victory.

apps.name: Freakshow CardGame
apps.short_description: Welcome to the Freakshow! Battle your friends in this turn-based strategy between two players and their army of "Freaks". Build your own teams and explore wacky characters and different strategies in this free-to-play brand new card game.

apps.name: From Dust We Came
apps.short_description: Competitive multiplayer FPS where the map is brand new every match. Nobody knows the layout, so it all comes down to how you play. Level up, master your guns, climb ranked, and bring your whole squad along.

apps.name: Full Deck: Euchre, Spades, Hearts, and More
apps.short_description: Eight trick-taking card games in one deck - Euchre and four special versions, plus Spades, and Hearts. Learn each from a tutorial that deals you a real hands it plays it with you. Rewrite house rules to match how your family plays. No internet connection needed.

apps.name: Fusa
apps.short_description: Pet Pochi, earn purrs and turn an empty room into a home full of cats. Fusa is a relaxing pixel-art incremental game: furnish with over 140 pieces, watch your cats nap, play and ask for food, and grow your colony up to thirty companions.

apps.name: Gbike
apps.short_description: Plasma bikes past 1,000 km/h on magnetic ribbon tracks laid over giant anime girls who are just living their day. Loops, wall rides, cannons, a 12-rider pack — and a story mode with cutscenes and on-foot stages. A futuristic racer in the spirit of the late '90s.

apps.name: GCR4 Geoff Crammond
apps.short_description: Geoff Crammond Racing 4 marks the return of a legendary sim racing experience. Featuring authentic driving physics, dynamic AI, full race weekends, and Steam Workshop support, GCR4 lets you relive the golden era of open-wheel racing with customization, realism, and depth.

apps.name: GET FIT - Men's Fitness
apps.short_description: Train with pro trainers, push your limits, and get stronger with every session! Choose your trainer, level, and routine — then jump into 30 minutes of intense, rewarding, and ever-changing full-body workouts.

apps.name: GHOSTLESS
apps.short_description: Lead an uprising against AI in a post-apocalyptic world where you’re never sure who is human and who is machine. Scavenge for resources, find survivors to grow your base, root out android infiltrators and lead the resistance in a unique hybrid of 2.5D action-adventure and colony building.

apps.name: Gimby
apps.short_description: Guard the Skull and Crown of the dead King of the Underworld. Explore, hunt, fish and build by day, then hold your tower against the horde each night.

apps.name: Girl & Scarecrow
apps.short_description: Something rotten roams the night. Venture deep into the woods behind your grandfather's house and track down an aviary lost to time in this fantasy visual novel game set in rural New Zealand.

apps.name: Goblin Mode: Loot & Lunacy
apps.short_description: A chaotic online co-op adventure for 2–4 players. Steal and throw shinies with your friends then build goblin technology to further your schemes. Destroy a village in a goblin truck then pickup the scraps or climb inside a trenchcoat with your friends and be a human for the day.

apps.name: Gonfalon
apps.short_description: A medieval real time strategy game where you plant banners instead of clicking every soldier. Grow a village, unlock buildings, survive ghosts and yetis, and march your army to conquer every rival kingdom.

apps.name: Grid Forge TD
apps.short_description: Stop continuous waves of enemies by building a maze in this free flowing tower defense game. Purchase upgrades between runs to become even more powerful and go further next time.

apps.name: GRIDLOCK GAMBIT
apps.short_description: A chess-themed roguelike tower defense. Carve out the enemy's path yourself, place white chess pieces as towers, and hold back the oncoming horde. Advance each tower along its evolution tree to make it stronger and unlock devastating ultimate moves.

apps.name: Grounds Crew
apps.short_description: Mow it. Blow it. Plow it. Take on 80 grounds-keeping jobs with a robot mower, a tractor and gang mower, a leaf blower and a snow blower. Lay perfect stripes, clear every leaf and push back the snow, from backyards and golf courses to castles and Christmas markets.

apps.name: Guildmaster Simulator
apps.short_description: Build and lead your own adventurers' guild in a fantasy world. Recruit and train heroes, manage your guild, uncover legendary quests, and forge your reputation across four distinct regions. Every expedition brings new opportunities, difficult choices, and consequences that shape your guild's story.

apps.name: Hakuroku Game Collection
apps.short_description: Hakuroku’s board games are coming to digital! The Early Access version is planned to include Hakoniwa Kings and Guild Build. Greedy Hunters! is planned to be added in an upcoming update.

apps.name: Halloween Fair: Tidy Up Together
apps.short_description: A little spooky. A lot to tidy. 2048 halloween items to be exact. Bring order to a moonlit Halloween fair in this cozy cleanup game for up to 4 players. Sort scattered decorations, earn festival sparks, and unlock upgrades that help the whole team turn a giant mess into a job well done.

apps.name: HamYam
apps.short_description: A fast-paced, competitive 2D platform racing game of hamsters competing through beautiful dream world tracks!

apps.name: Hatch Flap
apps.short_description: Go on an adventure to find your lost little baby flamingo and bring it back home. Will you be able to move forward with the whole world against you?

apps.name: Hay in a Needlestack
apps.short_description: Someone lost a piece of hay in a pile of 50 million needles. Dig it out alone or with up to 5 friends. Bare hands bleed. Climbing bleeds. The deep needles are rusty. Melt what you dig into metal and build drills, machines, and drones to dig faster, or trade it for bandages and tetanus shots.

apps.name: Hell Wait
apps.short_description: HELL WAIT is riichi mahjong crossed with roguelike deckbuilding. Stack your jokers. Upgrade your yaku. Try not to deal in. You'll need those fingers.

apps.name: Heroes Together VR
apps.short_description: Heroes Together VR is a 4-player co-op roguelite dungeon crawler. Pick your Hero, fight your way through Gobi Gulch, and figure out how to work as a team, because no run goes the same way twice.

apps.name: Heroic Frontline: Dawn Hymn
apps.short_description: This medieval‑fantasy card‑battle game focuses on hardcore combat and strategic gameplay. Breaking traditional one‑on‑one card duels, it deeply integrates hero progression, good‑evil conflict and town‑linked mechanics for a tactically‑rich, epic card battlefield.

apps.name: Highland Haven
apps.short_description: Discover your own private haven in the Scottish Highlands and bring this once thriving home for hairy “coos” back to life. Craft goodies to sell, optimize your farm, and grow a pasture of cute highland cows roaming free on the bottom of your screen in this relaxing idle game.

apps.name: HighLevelWorker
apps.short_description:
Play as high-altitude construction workers and tackle ridiculous tasks assigned by your foreman!
Your clients are a bizarre cast of iconic gaming characters-from bomb-plating terroristes and Assassin-hating Templars etc.
Team up with up to 8 players in chaotic co-op construction!

apps.name: Hop!
apps.short_description:
Take control of a revenge seeking bunny in Hop! a 2.5D cartoon-styled game. 
Jump, kick, dodge the uncontrollable riders, and seek your payback.

apps.name: How Many Tickets Does It Take To Win The Lottery?
apps.short_description: An incremental about one simple question. How many tickets does it take to win the lottery? Scratch tickets, match the numbers and spend your winnings on more tickets, until you are scratching millions at a time. The jackpot odds are realistic, 1 in 290,472,336, and nothing you buy changes it.

apps.name: HuntCore
apps.short_description: HuntCore is a Monster-Collecting Roguelike. Join the CoreSeekers to fight and catch magical beast called Hunts. A big story awaits you to discover.

apps.name: HypnoFish Inc.
apps.short_description: HypnoFish Inc. is a first-person incremental game about working for the world's largest fishing corporation. Hypnotize fish, sell your catch, purchase upgrades, and uncover the mystery of this fishy business!

apps.name: HYPNOSYNC
apps.short_description:
RHYTHM x HYPNOSIS. You are forced into being the manager of the brand new music game arcade, HYPNOSYNC!
With your newfound hypnosis ability, hypnotize customers to the beat and turn them into your very own mindless employees!

apps.name: Hyposolus
apps.short_description:
Hyposolus is an action role playing game with strategic elements.

A long time has passed and the world is shattered. Experiment with different perks and spell combinations to defeat enemies. Explore the floating islands and discover the past.  Reach the spirits calling for you.

apps.name: I Feel Great
apps.short_description: A short interactive narrative where you experience the daily grind, job, and exhaustion of a young woman — through simple interactions like typing and exploring. Inspired by the song "I'll Always Kill Myself Too Late" by Reclaimant of Life.

apps.name: I Married the Demon Lord's Daughter
apps.short_description: Adult-Only dark fantasy political romance Visual Novel where victory came with an unexpected price. You defeated the Demon Lord - only to inherit his throne and find yourself caught between two warring worlds.

apps.name: Imagical
apps.short_description: Answer strange questions. Keep a straight face when the images appear. Imagical is a party game for 4–8 people in the same room, using phones as controllers. Your answers become surprise AI-generated images, and everyone votes before finding out who's responsible.

apps.name: Infinite Polyhedra
apps.short_description: Gather up a shape-based army and defend yourself against the incoming darkness. INFINITE POLYHEDRA is a lane-based tower defense roguelike.

apps.name: Inquisitio
apps.short_description: The Holy Office burned you at the stake. At dusk, you wake among your own ashes. A pixel-art action roguelike, solo or in 2–4 player online co-op: descend into the Inquisition's prisons, face monstrous bosses and hunt the Inquisitor who condemned you.

apps.name: Inside The Shadows
apps.short_description: Inside The Shadows is a first-person psychological horror game with a heavy, realistic atmosphere. Embark on an intimate and unsettling journey as you explore every room of the house, uncovering secrets that shaped your life before you were born and reveal your family’s dark past.

apps.name: IRONVOW
apps.short_description: A gothic pixel-art action platformer with hard, fair boss fights. Parry, riposte and break their guard as you fight down ten cursed depths. After every level, swear a vow: a boon is straight power, a gamble is great power at a real price.

apps.name: I’m a Wizard, But I Dig
apps.short_description: Shorten your journey to the castle by digging a tunnel through the mountain. Use magic and craft: swing your pickaxe, cast spells, blow up obstacles, and light your path with glowing slimes. Trade resources with the Goose, unlock new tools, and uncover the mountain's secrets.

apps.name: JOCKEY RISING: BLOODLINE
apps.short_description: JOCKEY RISING: BLOODLINE is a jockey life sim with deck-building races. Start at 18 as a rookie, ride and raise horses at your family stable, breed your own bloodline, then retire and pass the stable and its legacy to your child.

apps.name: Journey Beyond the Gate
apps.short_description: Journey Beyond the Gate is a fantasy roguelite deckbuilder with classic RPG progression. Choose your race and class, build your deck with powerful card synergies, and explore a dangerous medieval fantasy world with tactical turn-based combat and deep character progression.

apps.name: Jugs Bay: Lust Stories
apps.short_description: An uncensored, fully voiced 3D adult visual novel. Spend a year in a sunny California beach town, romance five busty heroines, meet many more women and catch 100+ voyeur moments. 1,600+ animations with real jiggle physics, and every intimate scene is your choice.

apps.name: Junk Rush
apps.short_description: You’re a degenerate gambler with 28 days to pay your vig to the mob with your hotdog stand! Embark on a chaotic adventure with your mocking AI and schizophrenic Goblin. Explore the island, find bizarre ingredients, create insane hotdogs, break rules, cause chaos and do whatever it takes to survive!

apps.name: Jurassic Paradise
apps.short_description: Survive a dinosaur park with 3–8 players in an online game of cooperation and social deduction. Repair facilities, share supplies, and vote out suspects—or sabotage your friends as a hidden cultist. Transform into a dinosaur and turn suspicion into a chase.

apps.name: Just Another Soldier
apps.short_description: Defend Troy as a nameless soldier. Fall, and rise again in another soldier's body. Hold the walls against thousands of Greeks and mythic monsters in this low-poly action defense roguelite. Mix level-up cards, divine powers and siege weapons, then upgrade your fortress for good with Soul Gems.

apps.name: KILLDOZER SIMULATOR
apps.short_description: A top-down destruction roguelite. Drive an armored bulldozer through a living town, level the buildings on your grudge list, and turn your treads against everyone who tries to stop you.

apps.name: KPOP Idol Factory
apps.short_description: A K-pop drama where your choices matter – now the Aurora Edition: glowing Aurora outfits, two new idols, six new songs, photo mode, story archive, endings and free play. Fresh drama every day in chats, story scenes and comics.

apps.name: KRISENSTAB
apps.short_description: A 1917 co-op war cabinet for 1–4 players. Each minister is sealed in their own bunker office, and the only way to talk is the desk telephone, wrong numbers and all. Run the war together, ring the bell, and let the guards march you to the locked meeting.

apps.name: Lab Loonies
apps.short_description: Lab Loonies is a physics-based descent into madness where "logic" is a suggestion the developer ignored. In this 1-4 player lab experiment, the platforms are lying, the physics are "opinionated," and the Narrator is actively rooting for your demise. Make good choices, or don't. The Lab doesn't judge

apps.name: Labyrinth Stars
apps.short_description: Wobbly astronauts, a giant maze floating in space and zero chance of staying on your feet! Grab, dive and bump your way through puzzles, traps and parkour chaos. Only the fastest space cadets make it to the podium!

apps.name: Lantern Hollow
apps.short_description: You inherited a mountain bed-and-breakfast where guests keep checking in and the register says nobody has ever checked out. Four adults. One book. A cozy-horror mystery visual novel where the person you fall for decides what the town's curse really is — and what you do about it.

apps.name: LAST SHELTER
apps.short_description: Explore, survive, loot and evacuate in a zombie-infested world. Upgrade your weapons and vehicles, recruit survivors, build your shelter, and defend it against increasingly dangerous zombie hordes.

apps.name: Last Thaw
apps.short_description: Low-poly hardcore zombie survival where the cold is as deadly as the dead. Scavenge a 3.3 km map, build and defend a base, tune cars and drive out on frozen lakes, and hold out through the seasons, alone or in co-op with up to 8. No health bar: read your body.

apps.name: Late Night Duty
apps.short_description: A short, linear narrative-driven psychological horror walking simulator set in Malaysia. Play as a traumatized veteran on his first night as a school security guard, where routine patrols quickly reveal that something is wrong within the school.

apps.name: Lawful Evil
apps.short_description: An online 2-6 player courtroom party game where you and your friends become chaotic lawyers, arguing before an AI cast that runs locally on your PC. Talk to clients, build your case, then take on your friends in court. Will you be the lawyer everyone calls, or the one they regret calling?

apps.name: Lazy River
apps.short_description: A co-op adventure at the galaxy's most unregulated waterpark. Some guy peed in the pool, and the pee mixed with the space water and turned everybody into zombies… Except you and your friends. Build a raft, ride down the Lazy River, and escape before you run out of hot dogs!

apps.name: Leash Kid
apps.short_description: A physics based chaos game starring Leash Kid! a tiny terror with big plans and a very short leash. Smash products, topple bystanders, and wreck the store, before Mom drags you out screaming.

apps.name: Liar’s Line
apps.short_description: A monster is hiding behind one of the voices on the line. Identify the liar before you reveal your location. One wrong judgment, and it comes to your door. Each playthrough changes who's lying.

apps.name: Life's Too Short: A Christmas Spirit
apps.short_description: A little Christmas adventure game featuring a problem solving ghost. In Life's Too Short: A Christmas Spirit, someone's been put on the naughty list and it's up to you to solve puzzles, meet quirky characters, fix their problems and ultimately put things right in the mansion.

apps.name: Listening Post: Typing Tower Defense
apps.short_description: Master English listening with the ultimate dictation challenge! This real-time tower defense game lets you build and upgrade defenses by typing what you hear. Use 12 tower branches and the Fever system to sharpen your intuition. The faster you listen and type, the stronger your defense!

apps.name: Logical Cat Logistics
apps.short_description: Let yesterday's you lend a paw! Deliver curious parcels as a cat courier, then record your footsteps and team up with your past self. Conveyors, gates and sorting switches move one beat at a time. Take your time, try a new route, and turn a tangled delivery into a perfectly timed handoff.

apps.name: Los días después de que todo se fue al carajo
apps.short_description:
A visual novel set in a post-apocalyptic world where the dead aren't the only thing to worry about.
Every decision matters as the story unfolds. Every choice can shape the fate of the community.
Join Miguel and his group on an adventure driven by a single goal: survival.

apps.name: Love or Lust Beach Stories
apps.short_description: Tropical paradise where every cocktail you mix shapes your fate. Build relationships and choose between love and lust in a next-gen adult visual novel with stunning 3D visuals and choice-driven gameplay.

apps.name: LOVE X LOVE
apps.short_description:
Play a gig-economy driver searching for love as the fate of the universe hangs in the balance. 
Drive the night. 
Tune your dreams. 
Chase love.

apps.name: Lucky Debt
apps.short_description: A roguelike about debt. Eight deadlines, one rigged slot machine, and a simple problem: the money that keeps you alive is the money that makes you stronger. Build a deck of symbols and charms, chain multipliers, and pay what you owe — or don't.

apps.name: Lucky Grid
apps.short_description: A cosy two-hour pixel game about a table of lucky machines in an old house. Toss the coin, roll the dice, spin the wheel and pull the slots, automate them all, step into the garden inside a plant and climb to the attic, where a ginger cat talks in cat.

apps.name: Lucky Rabbit
apps.short_description:
GAMBLE to pay off your debts! Buy power ups (drugs) to increase profit and see how large your bankroll can get! Play Slots, Casino Classics, and more! Remember: 
Fortune favors the bold, go all in!

apps.name: Luminara: The Second Dawn
apps.short_description: Medieval fantasy daughter-raising sim with adventure and romance elements. You are a single father, and every step of your daughter's journey is yours to guide. Study, adventure, make friends, fall in love… 70+ endings, each playthrough a new story. Ready to raise the most wonderful daughter of all?

apps.name: Lustrya
apps.short_description: An erotic fantasy brothel management game set in an enchanted kingdom. With a mix of arcade gameplay, story-driven campaign and intimate interactions, you’ll forge alliances, expand your stronghold and shape the destiny of a world built on desire.

apps.name: Magehold Wanderlight
apps.short_description: A black storm of living ink is swallowing the world. Gather a small crew, build a cozy house on giant legs, and walk ahead of it. Harvest, trade and grow your walker by day, defend it by lamplight at night, until you are strong enough to turn around and face the storm.

apps.name: Maiden Covenant: The Infernal Citadel
apps.short_description: A solo rogue-lite combining deckbuilding and board tactics. Build a deck and play cards governed by movement and combat rules. Seize Magic Ore, manage resources, and face relentless foes. Lead allies across four territories, challenge the Infernal Citadel, and restore order to a shattered world!

apps.name: MASALA FIX: A Bollywood Rhythm Game | マサラ修理
apps.short_description: Broken appliances, a repair stall in a busy Indian street, and only one way to fix them: jam on them to the customer's song! Hit D F J K however you like for 32 bars. Nail the offbeats and it hums back to life. Miss, and... BOOM. A Bollywood rhythm game from Holi to Diwali.

apps.name: MATE, This Place is a MESS!
apps.short_description: MATE, This Place is a MESS! is a cozy organizing game where you sort 5,000 yerba mate packages in a messy museum. Fill the shelves, brew your mate, unlock abilities and kick packages into place. At the end of the hall, a huge curtain hides the truth about the museum. What could it be?

apps.name: Matecalipsis: El Último Mate
apps.short_description: A turn-based deckbuilding roguelike set in an Argentina without yerba mate. Choose your character, build your deck, combine amulets, and battle creatures from Argentine folklore on a journey full of strange encounters and tough choices.

apps.name: Meat Hell
apps.short_description: A meat based real time strategy game. Harvest chunks of meat for resources, build meat tanks and train meat zombies. A second faction will fight against the meat. Story rich single player campaign for each faction, as well as skirmish, LAN and online multiplayer.

apps.name: MicroTD
apps.short_description: MicroTD - endless incremental minimalist tower defense game where player decides when enemy difficulty should go up.

apps.name: Mini Battleships
apps.short_description: Start with a tiny boat and a single gun. Sink ships, salvage their gold and turn your vessel into a gloriously over-armed floating fortress. A calm, minimalist naval roguelike with an ever-changing soundtrack, where the sea always wins in the end, but never before you look magnificent.

apps.name: Mini Monuments
apps.short_description: Mini Monuments is a calming diorama restoration game where you dig, clean, and rebuild handcrafted miniature ruins. Use tactile tools at your own pace and watch as each scene comes back to life piece by piece.

apps.name: Minotaur Princess
apps.short_description: A silly/serious, story-driven Puzzle Fighter RPG where your choices shape your path. It’s part silly in that you’re a princess that gets Freaky Friday’d with a minotaur! It’s also part serious in that two people who love each other get sent to the gallows in the first 2 minutes. Versus is BA too!

apps.name: MINSK: APOCALYPSE
apps.short_description: Survive apocalyptic Minsk. Manage health, food and water: search for resources or complete missions to stay alive. Fight demons, Templars and criminal factions as you investigate the apocalypse and those responsible. A survival adventure in development.

apps.name: Missing body
apps.short_description: Find the body of the deceased, but beware: the murderers are still on the loose. Missing Body is a team-based multiplayer game where murderers and investigators face off. Use your character's unique abilities to win the match.

apps.name: Monkeyspeare: Infinite monkey theorem
apps.short_description: Help a jungle full of monkeys, each hammering away at a typewriter at random, finish Shakespeare's complete works.

apps.name: Mossback
apps.short_description: Tend a little farm on the mossy back of an ancient sea turtle as it drifts through the seasons. Slowly unlock an arcade-like selection of mini-games that cater to different interests. Share what you grow with a very old friend and watch the island rise.

apps.name: MUAY THAI XTREME
apps.short_description: The first multiplayer fighter built entirely around Muay Thai. Authentic technique, tactical depth, and ring pressure that punishes any mistake. Build your fighter, climb the ranks, and join the Pre-Season: No Surrender for rewards that won't return after launch.

apps.name: Murdeo
apps.short_description: A first-person social deduction game for 4–12 players. Guests and staff gather in a dark country mansion. Do your duties, watch each other closely and find out who among you is the murderer – before the evening runs out and nobody is left to accuse anyone.

apps.name: My Massage
apps.short_description: Give your big sister a massage, help her fall asleep, and sneak in some naughty mischief! A smoothly animated Live2D massage & sex simulation game. Chat with her while massaging different parts of her body. As she gets sleepier, new areas become touchable and her reactions change. Don't wake her up!

apps.name: My Spooky Photo Store Lydia
apps.short_description: My Spooky Photo Store: Lydia is a relaxing jigsaw puzzle game with 20 progressively challenging levels. Solve each puzzle to unlock the next chapter of Lydia's story, leading to a final exciting sequence.

apps.name: México 1920-1940: Heirs of the Revolution
apps.short_description: A turn-based narrative political sim: govern Mexico from the presidency, 1920–1940. Build your cabinet, lobby Congress, negotiate with rebels and send troops into battle without knowing how far they’ll obey. What if Zapata had become president? Or Villa? 75 endings, from historical to far-fetched.

apps.name: Near Mint
apps.short_description: Create your own cards and combine them in a unique and everchanging deck. Explore and battle through hostile lands, encounter bizarre creatures and craft the perfect strategy in this roguelike deckbuilder.

apps.name: Nekkestu Curling Girls
apps.short_description: Arcade curling in a shonen sports manga!? Yell, sweep, curl. Play through single player manga campaigns and challenge your friends to see who is the top skip. Use unique abilities and power moves to prove your curling prowess!

apps.name: NEKO MAKER 2: Starlit Girl
apps.short_description: Her story starts with the name you give her. Raise a cat-eared girl from six to eighteen: plan her learning each term, respond to everyday moments, and choose how to spend the holidays. Balance time and money, nurture her talents and bonds, and uncover the mystery of the starlit cage.

apps.name: Neon Sliders
apps.short_description: Neon Sliders is a High Adrenaline 80s Synthewave Pod Racer were you go pod-to-pod with 120 racers.

apps.name: Never Ending Trail
apps.short_description: Build a custom mobile fortress on legs. Crash-land in the Wild West, scavenge your wrecked ship, transform it into a walking mech base and roam an endless, procedurally generated western frontier. Build, Loot, and Survive your way through a world that never lets you stop.

apps.name: Night Audit
apps.short_description: Work the night shift at a hotel that is quietly wrong. Answer the bell, mop the corridors, hand out keys — and deal with whatever is on the fourth floor. Co-op for one to four porters, where the job is mundane, the building is not, and guess what: nobody is coming to help.

apps.name: Nightcup
apps.short_description: Pull up a chair: in Nightcup everything is played at one table. Four classics on the shelf, plus various modes and house rules you can switch on. Fill the empty seats with bots or invite your Steam friends straight into your lobby. No long loading screens in between.

apps.name: NIGHTMARE OF THE FOREST
apps.short_description: Join Johnny on a desperate search for his missing daughter in a mysterious forest. Confront the shadows and the presence of Marcus in this immersive horror experience.

apps.name: No Nightmares Allowed
apps.short_description: No Nightmares Allowed is a co-op survival horror for 1-4 players. Manage a bunker hotel in Sector 4, inspect incoming guests, and check database to stop disguise nightmares. Complete daily quotas to afford dream-sickness medicine, and grab weapons to survive if a monster gets inside.

apps.name: NULL Heart
apps.short_description: A roguelike, bullet-heaven inspired rail-shooter where relentless gunfire fuels game-breaking damage engines. Tinker with item mod combos to discover unexpected synergies and chain exponential multipliers until projectiles fill the screen and enemies melt.

apps.name: ODD ODDS
apps.short_description: A single-player roguelike gambling game set entirely in one room. To clear a crushing debt, win coins at the claw machine, cash out at the ATM, and upgrade at the typewriter before the devil collects. Then the doorbell rings. Ally, or scammer? Who you deal with decides whether you get out.

apps.name: OmniMart Tycoon
apps.short_description: Design and manage the ultimate retail empire in OmniMart Tycoon! Build complex store layouts, optimize daily supply chains, and set prices. Hire staff and watch hundreds of simulated shoppers navigate your aisles as you balance profits with ultimate customer satisfaction.

apps.name: On My Watch
apps.short_description: On My Watch is a first-person psychological horror game set during an overnight hospital security shift. Monitor surveillance cameras, patrol empty halls, investigate disturbing events, and question what you can trust as the hospital slowly becomes something much worse.

apps.name: One more, please
apps.short_description: The Swallow is open again on the Melancholy Shores. Keep the shift alive, pour under pressure, and answer for every yes, no, and glass. Regulars don't need saving - they need a bartender who stays, and a drink that tells the truth.

apps.name: Ore Heads
apps.short_description: Head Office is hiring! Dig through ever-changing caves in co-op for up to 16 players, sell your haul, build a home on your own plot and climb the company ladder from Intern Digger to Chairman of the Boulder in this cozy voxel mining game.

apps.name: Otherwill
apps.short_description: Otherwill is a non-linear sci-fi horror visual novel with a cinematic, atmospheric style. Those who step onto the surface of this planet will never return the same.

apps.name: PachiRogue
apps.short_description: Pachinko meets horde survival in a tactile cardboard diorama. Drop balls into cascading peg boards to trigger runaway chain reactions before the climbing army breaches your wall. Draft game-breaking ball synergies, level up RPG stats, and survive the climb.

apps.name: Panic Heist
apps.short_description: Grab your friends and steal some treasure! Panic Heist is a physics-based co-op heist game starring a gang of chicken thieves. Raid a museum, use Tools and upgrades to outsmart its security, and escape with the loot. Just try not to blow up your crew.

apps.name: Parasite Core
apps.short_description: Buy time to harvest resources in this incremental tower defense game where you defend your core from the native species that want you off their home! Play actively and unleash your abilities, or idle and let your turrets take care of the pests.

apps.name: Pawn Shop Days
apps.short_description: Run a pawnshop: inspect goods, haggle with unusual visitors, repair your finds and sell them on. Spot fakes, decide whose story to trust and invest your profits in the shop. Between questionable deals, take a moment to pet the kitten.

apps.name: Pick The Suspect
apps.short_description: A cozy puzzle game about finding one person in a crowd. Read the note, check the clues and wave at the right person. Pick the wrong one and they just wave back. 100 levels across 10 places, from a quiet town square to a busy night carnival.

apps.name: Pirate Treasure: Tidy Up!
apps.short_description: Attention, greenhorn! Prove you’re worthy of joining the crew by tidying up our chaotic treasure vault. Sort every piece of loot into its rightful place, upgrade your sluggish hands with hooks and peglegs, and discover hidden skills along the way!

apps.name: PITH
apps.short_description: Traverse a wonderful and strange world, find playful tools, and uncover secrets in PITH, a metroidbrainia/puzzle-platforming adventure full of twists and surprises.

apps.name: Pixel Chaos: Tidy Up the Museum
apps.short_description: A cozy first-person organizing game set in a chaotic Victorian museum. Gather scattered colored cubes, carry them in stacks, and place them into matching slots to reveal pixel artworks and restore charming 3D voxel exhibits.

apps.name: Pixel Pegz
apps.short_description: Cozy puzzle and arcade games to play your way: in a little window that stays on top while you work, on Steam Deck, or on the couch with a controller. Untangle arrows, pour sand, sort hex stacks or squish jelly, one bite-sized round at a time.

apps.name: Pocket Furry
apps.short_description: Pocket Furry is a relaxing and heartfelt dating simulator where your choices matter. There are no right or wrong answers. Just choose what she likes.

apps.name: Poliklinika: Physician Simulator
apps.short_description: A pixel-art doctor simulator in a run-down Soviet-style clinic. Question patients, examine them, read their charts and spot forged referrals. Then prescribe, refer or refuse, and sign and stamp it yourself while the clock keeps ticking. Most patients don't need what they ask for.

apps.name: Ponshot
apps.short_description: Ponshot is an explosive brawler party game of brutal ball strikes in 2.5D urban environments. Run, dodge, launch and hit your opponents with powerful ball strikes, they don't just break bones... they shatter friendships!

apps.name: Pot Smasher
apps.short_description: A point-and-click game where you smash pots, collect coins, buy upgrades, and smash even more pots.

apps.name: President Club 27
apps.short_description: En el fútbol moderno el partido se decide en los despachos. Toma el control de un club desde el fútbol modesto hasta la élite o salva a un gigante en crisis. Destituye técnicos, negocia derechos de TV, supera mociones de censura y cumple tus promesas electorales. En President Club 27 tú mandas.

apps.name: Prey Island
apps.short_description: Stranded on an island of dinosaurs with a pistol and a knife. Ammo is scarce and there are no shops. Every raptor you meet is a choice: fight, run, or slip past. Find three missing parts, repair the tower, and call for rescue before the island takes you.

apps.name: Primal Repairs
apps.short_description: Primal Repairs is a humorous Stone Age handyman simulator. Fix dino-powered gadgets, help cavemen with absurd tasks, and use your loyal Velly as the ultimate multi-tool in an open prehistoric world.

apps.name: Project 1815
apps.short_description: Full Scale First/Third Person Napoleonic Tactical Action! Fight alongside thousands of troops in both singleplayer and multiplayer as you captain individual infantry battalions, cavalry squadrons, and artillery batteries, or take command from above as your team's general in round-based team battles.

apps.name: Project Babel
apps.short_description: A falling-block roguelike where fast hands meet ruthless strategy. Activate runes by typing, combine Oaths to raise the Heat, and create custom maps with your own objectives and restrictions. As sanity shifts, so do the rules you must survive.

apps.name: Project Hole
apps.short_description: A cosy digging game set in a British back garden. Shovel, pick and drill through turf, clay and rock, sell every load, upgrade your tools and build ladders, belts and lifts as you dig hundreds of metres down to unearth treasures, crystal caves, lava and a buried secrets. Dig alone or with friends.

apps.name: PROPERTY INSPECTION
apps.short_description: You are Inspector 8821-A of Structural Core Services. Unit 47 has four reported concerns, each marked with a sticker by the child who lives there. Peel it. Inspect it. Tick the box. The report on your clipboard knows more than you do.

apps.name: Purgatorial Learning
apps.short_description: Purgatorial Learning drags you deep into dreams and nightmares that weave through each other, capturing you into its otherworldly web. Explore this nightmare, find the cracks within and escape from a dream that isn't yours!

apps.name: Push Wars
apps.short_description: A fast paced MOBA that is easy to pick up and play with friends. Conquer the map and dominate the battleground!

apps.name: PYRTHEOS
apps.short_description: Turn-based strategy where you adapt your culture to the terrain. Eliminate RNG through Tech, Culture, and Edicts. Manage cities, expand borders in procedural worlds, and survive the clash of civilizations. Your vision is the ultimate solution to the map's challenge.

apps.name: Qamar
apps.short_description: Precision ball racing built entirely around physics and flow.  Master gravity and momentum in high-speed rolling time trials.

apps.name: Quarantine Zombies - Prologue 2
apps.short_description: The prologue continues with new exclusive quests and a deadly dungeon. Survive the first 8 days in post-apocalyptic Chicago, where FPS action meets quarantine inspection. Repair your car and fight your way to the main checkpoint to save your younger brother. The army arrives in 30 days.

apps.name: Quiet Bloom
