apps.short_description: Quiet Bloom is a cozy idle game. Awaken the wind, dig wells, and call the rain to tend your land for you. Gather wood, stone, and water, raise wind vanes and solar panels, and watch a cracked desert slowly bloom into a luxuriant green oasis.

apps.name: Quiz Show Simulator
apps.short_description: Run your own high-stakes quiz show by crafting questions, choosing contestants, and making production decisions to grow your audience, boost ratings, and earn more money!

apps.name: Rank Risk: Guess the Order
apps.short_description: Rank six answer cards in the correct order, choose how much RP to risk, and use limited attempts to solve each puzzle. Build streaks, chase bigger payouts, and climb the leaderboards in this fast-paced trivia ranking game.

apps.name: Re: The Adventures of Dreik and Xitilon
apps.short_description: Dreik visits a friend and ends up in another world, living inside a giant statue of Lenin—with his own clone out to kill him. Explore, solve bizarre puzzles, and find a way home in a 3D comedy adventure with anime-style storytelling, absurd humour, and moments that hit hard.

apps.name: Reality Drift
apps.short_description: Reality Drift is a strategic roguelike racing game. Race through a series of strange worlds, choose upgrades, cards and relics, and decide which track will be next - your decisions are just as important as how you drive!

apps.name: Realm Runners
apps.short_description: Realm Runners is an isometric extraction action RPG. Fight through hordes and face bosses that test your timing. Loot gear, shape your build and survive a brutal tournament for a chance to claim your one true wish. Extract with your loot or push your luck. Get greedy and you might die wishing.

apps.name: Reddy & Smoky's Flappy Storm
apps.short_description: Flap through a raging thunderstorm as Reddy, a plucky red parrot carrying his kitten co-pilot Smoky! Dodge tornadoes, chase high scores, and conquer the storm in this one-button arcade thrill-ride.

apps.name: Reel Tiny
apps.short_description: Become the fisherman you were always meant to be in Reel Tiny. Experience life as a tiny creature in a big world as you catch fish and make friends. Trade with the town to upgrade your lures and fishing rod. Earn new fishing licenses to explore new sections of the creek and become an angling legend!

apps.name: Refugee of a Lost Age
apps.short_description: A civilian survival sim in a collapsing dynasty. Chop wood, break rocks, pick herbs, farm — but this is no cozy farming game. Fight tooth and nail for every grain of food. Villagers aren't there to be befriended: only barter, deceit, robbery. To survive, will you do wrong — or stay human?

apps.name: Replay Value: Second Hand Games
apps.short_description: Run a second-hand game store from scratch! A Job Simulator where you buy and sell used games, negotiate with colorful customers, make profit and upgrade your shop! Clean up retro finds, and stack your shelves with the most popular game with replay value!

apps.name: Rip It! Card Collector
apps.short_description: A single-player incremental game where you rip boosters and collect cards to complete the ultimate collection. Sell dupes, upgrade your gear and automate your setup to pull more cards, quicker! Enjoy the satisfaction of ripping packs, filling your binder, and gathering all sets. Let's get cracking!

apps.name: River Secret
apps.short_description: A story about a beautiful river that hides deadly secrets beneath its calm surface.

apps.name: Rocket Scrapyard
apps.short_description: Tidy up a private space company's scrapyard, collect rocket parts into sets on your racks and build your own rocket every evening. In the morning it launches – will it reach the edge of space, orbit, or help build a space station?

apps.name: Roll to Hell
apps.short_description: Launch a tire down a brutal 7,000-metre descent to Hell in this physics-driven incremental roguelite. Smash through shifting biomes, hoard resources and upgrade your way deeper. Roll solo, or ruin friendships in up to 4-player couch PvP.

apps.name: Rotland
apps.short_description: A brutal zombie survival sandbox in an Earth-sized procedural world. Scavenge, craft, and build a home or mobile base. Drive cars, sail boats, pilot planes and helicopters, or take to the rails on a train. Survive alone or with friends.

apps.name: Rozmari
apps.short_description:
Fantasy medieval RPG following the plight and pilgrimage of a rabbit lass.
Navigate environmental puzzles and use survival skills to combat harsh challenges on your journey.
Discover ancient lore hidden within the spirit world to help you find the way.

apps.name: Rusty Flagon
apps.short_description: Beyond the last safe village lies a forest filled with monsters. Build and manage a thriving medieval inn, welcome weary heroes, expand your settlement, and turn a humble refuge into a legendary haven at the edge of darkness.

apps.name: SacriFrogos
apps.short_description: A roguelike strategy and survival game where ever-growing sacrifices are required to keep the mysterious Eternal Flame alive. Build a colony of Frogos and create unique builds every run.

apps.name: Salvo Spire
apps.short_description: Build upward. Defend in 360 degrees. SALVO SPIRE is a sci-fi tower defense game where weapon combinations and construction order shape distinct defensive builds. Expand your tower, upgrade its firepower, and direct focused fire against enemies closing in from every side.

apps.name: Sand Horde
apps.short_description: Sand Horde is an intense top-down survival shooter. Blast through relentless mutant hordes, explore surface ruins and multi-level sewer networks, craft modular weapons, construct underground bunkers, and drive armed go-karts to locate the "Big Cheese" and extract alive.

apps.name: Saturday AM: Battle Manga
apps.short_description: For the first time ever, Saturday AM’s iconic manga heroes unite in a crossover fighter! Tag in Sano, Cast, and more fan favorites to battle it out in explosive 2.5D combat where worlds collide.

apps.name: SCP-ELM0
apps.short_description: A first-person stealth horror game in an SCP Foundation facility. Hide, listen and never answer the voices: the thing stalking Sublevel D learns how you hide, wears your dead team's voices, and remembers you.

apps.name: Scrambled Ships
apps.short_description: A Yacht Dice Roguelike set on a ship with a mysterious figure, trapped in an endless game night atop a sunset cruise. Think outside the box, buy items, and progress through the rounds, or fall to the ever-increasing score targets.

apps.name: Sexorcism
apps.short_description: Sexorcism is an adult game combining roulette and spell-build crafting. As Ely runs out of Mana in battle, you become her exclusive “Provider.” Fight monsters by her side with Spells, Artifacts, and a “special” way to replenish Mana and turn fate around.

apps.name: sfsim
apps.short_description:
sfsim is a realistic 3D space flight simulator.
Use an advanced single-stage-to-orbit space craft to take off, orbit the planet, perform reentry, and land back on Earth.
sfsim features a true to scale Earth planet using NOAA elevation data and procedurally generated volumetric clouds.

apps.name: Shepherd's Keeper
apps.short_description: A Scripture-centered shepherding and homestead game. Tend your flock, grow a garden and make a home through the seasons. Choose your calendar and observance path, with Torah observance central when chosen. Single-player now; multiplayer planned.

apps.name: Shitbox Together
apps.short_description: Shitbox Together is a solo or co-op sandbox where you build, break, and fix your car. Explore the open world, earn money, pay bills, find parts, and keep your shitbox running for as long as possible.

apps.name: SIFT
apps.short_description: SIFT is a fast 2D action platformer about momentum. Fire your hook, push off thin air to dash and reset your jump, grab the key, hit the door — then do it again, faster. 50+ handcrafted levels. Race the clock, your friends, or everyone at once.

apps.name: Sigilbound
apps.short_description: A turn-based hero collector RPG you buy once. Recruit champions from six factions, tune their gear and speed until your team acts before the boss does, and farm on Repeat at your own pace. No energy, no shop, no paid summons: every champion is earned in play.

apps.name: SIM Chef: Restaurant management
apps.short_description: SIM Chef is a restaurant sim that starts on an empty lot. Build the dining room and the kitchen, choose from over 200 dishes and drinks from around the world and hire a team that knows how to make your menu. Win over the judges and take home awards.

apps.name: SLOW ORBIT: Idle Planet Conquest
apps.short_description: Slow Orbit puts a tiny, self-running space war in the bottom corner of your screen. Leave your fleet to conquer planets while you do other things, then drop in to buy upgrades, pick promotions and take on tougher defenses.

apps.name: Solbrand
apps.short_description: 2409. As the new Spook on HMS Solbrand you dive deep into a past steeped in grand norse myth and quiet local legend. Command your submersible, survey sunken ruins, uncover puzzling fragments, commune with the dead, and untangle a pseudo-historical knot of cosmic proportions: Why is the sun so loud?

apps.name: SOME: Space Overlay Mining Empire
apps.short_description:
Looking for SOME game right on your desktop that doesn't hijack your monitors?
A space station in a corner of your screen, mining ships that cut asteroids apart block by block and haul the ore home, and upgrades that let the fleet run itself while you pretend to work.

apps.name: SON of SPARTA
apps.short_description: Play as ACTARIUS, the ultimate Spartan warrior as he battles hes way through Hades underworld to be with hes beloved once more...

apps.name: Sonic Terror
apps.short_description: The year is 1984. You are the last band in a tiny Republic invaded by body-snatching space aliens. Music is the only weapon. You are wanted dead or alive. Explore a dystopian world where music is key to saving mankind and every gig is a challenging tactical clash.

apps.name: Soul Link - End and Rebirth
apps.short_description: An offline turn-based RPG of card-framed battles, party growth, and a two-act story. Unlock memory fragments, face trials, and choose among three finales. No energy gates or daily login chores—buy once and play through.

apps.name: Soul Shine
apps.short_description: Prohibition ruined your brewery job. So you started a moonshine business. Expand and automate your empire by harvesting souls, trafficking organs, selling to addicts, and serving strange gods.

apps.name: Soul Surge
apps.short_description:
Soul Surge is a stylized third-person action roguelite. 
Fight your way through 3 Domains with challenging boss fights, deep build opportunities, ARPG styled progression and Bullethell elements.

apps.name: SoulMarkWalker
apps.short_description: 《SoulMarkWalker》 is a turn-based action game.Choose your skills and time your dodges and counters in video-driven, turn-based combat. Investigate clues, develop your character, and resonate with ancient heroes.

apps.name: Sound System
apps.short_description: Play the songs you love, including the ones you wrote. Sound System is a rock rhythm game for guitar, bass, and drums, with a built-in chart editor that turns any track into a playable chart. Chase gold in Pro Mode or just jam in Classic. If you can hear it, you can play it.

apps.name: SpaceCorps
apps.short_description: A free-to-play space MMO in early alpha. Enlist with one of three companies, hunt aliens, fight rival pilots in the Danger Sectors, build ships and join a clan. Runs on Space3d, our own game engine written in Rust.

apps.name: SPECTR: Rekindle the World
apps.short_description: Become the Spark that brings a faded world back to life. Gather shards, automate production, and begin new cycles with permanent upgrades. An atmospheric incremental game about growth, discovery, and restoring a ruined valley.

apps.name: Stack the Spells
apps.short_description: Stack the Spells is a fantasy roguelike deckbuilder where every card is a step toward your survival. Scale a shifting, procedurally generated path, outsmart grim monstrosities in tactical turn-based combat, and forge a legendary deck to solve the mysteries of a world in ruin.

apps.name: Stackade
apps.short_description: Tower defense where your towers fall as blocks. Drag each piece onto the board, wall in your HQ and turn the gaps into kill zones. Every enemy comes at you its own way, bosses test your build, and between waves the Armory never has enough money for everything you want.

apps.name: Star TD
apps.short_description: Command your defense in an ever-changing roguelite TD. Harvest resources from mine nodes, explore the fog of war, and repel alien waves. With a deep branching tech tree and permanent progression, every defeat is just a step toward ultimate power. Build. Die. Research. Repeat.

apps.name: Star-Soldier
apps.short_description: Old retro style Sci-fi game from the 80's. This is the classic space invaders format. 114 levels of shooter fun, end level bosses and special weapon power up's.

apps.name: StarsPartyNext
apps.short_description:
2D action game featuring exhilarating gameplay driven by dashes and combos.
Keep an eye on the actions and reactions of Spica—a cool yet adorable boy who wields the power of the stars!
With over 30 stages, the game offers plenty of replay value through features like score attacks and time trials.

apps.name: STEP ASIDE!
apps.short_description: You are an invincible bodyguard. Your only weakness is the person you must protect. Control the crowd, spot the assassin, and execute the mission in this stylish, top-down tactical shooter.

apps.name: Sticker Mirage
apps.short_description: Play as Sticker Line, a 711 emergency call center worker. He lives his quiet life until strange and unfortunate events begin to occur, and he might be somehow connected. Discover the truth behind Sticker's quiet life in this dreamcore-style visual novel with horror elements.

apps.name: Stinky Tofu: Kitchen Survivor
apps.short_description: A chaotic kitchen action-roguelite where you play as stinky tofu, auto-aim through hordes of mutant ingredients, fuse kitchen weapons, mutate mid-run, and fight to stay fresh before you spoil.

apps.name: Stock Escape
apps.short_description: Trade 50 stocks, dodge loan sharks and con men, and blow your fortune on mansions, yachts and private jets. A funny stock market life sim where every hot tip comes with a catch, a kidnapping or a shark. Escape to your dreams.

apps.name: Stolen Frequencies
apps.short_description: Run a pirate radio station from a repair-shop back room in 1980s England. Find cassettes, win listeners and stay ahead of the police. Fix radios, grow local businesses and work towards your own music venue in this single-player simulation.

apps.name: Stompworks
apps.short_description: They fired you, then repossessed your whole town. They missed the mech under the tarp. Build a war machine from 59 parts, put a different gun on each arm, and stomp through 10 levels of wave combat and boss fights to take it all back. One mech. One run. No continues.

apps.name: StoneSpace
apps.short_description: As the lone survivor of an ill-fated starship, embark on the ultimate crafting project: build a vessel from scratch and return to Earth. Explore, gather resources, erect a base, and master hundreds of recipes – from flint tools to nuclear reactors - on a voyage through the entire history of science.

apps.name: Strict Order
apps.short_description: A 3D anomaly and document inspection sim set in a post-civil war dystopia. Match documents and detect hidden entities using gadgets on your diegetic desk. Survive before your booth glass breaks, manage your budget, and face the consequences of your actions on the evening news.

apps.name: Subroutine: Deep Space
apps.short_description: A sci-fi programming puzzle game. Repair corrupted ship cores by wiring executable node graphs — memory, logic, and I/O — then step through playback like a debugger until every validation stream passes.

apps.name: Sudokiller
apps.short_description: Sudokiller is a cozy mystery puzzle game where you place suspects on a sudoku-style grid to unmask a killer hiding in plain sight. Every guest leaves a clue pinning down where they stood at the time of the murder. Deduce your way through case after case in this cozy, cleverly deceptive mystery.

apps.name: Supa-Market: Japanese Super-Market Simulator
apps.short_description: Manage your own Japanese supermarket! Stock shelves, restock products, hire employees, and expand your store. Manage your finances, serve customers, and turn a small shop into a thriving business in a charming anime-inspired 3D simulation!

apps.name: Super Kanji Flash
apps.short_description: A cute anime action runner where you fight off ink aliens by reading the kanji they stole. Answer each one with a single press mid-run, and your brush strikes the alien down. Learn 6,000+ kanji, from zero to JLPT N1 and beyond. Play solo or in online co-op for up to 8.

apps.name: Sweeplings
apps.short_description:
A cute logic puzzle about scanning the board to find Starlings and avoid Boomlings. English UI · No spoken dialogue.

If you love logic puzzles like Minesweeper but want something warmer and more visual — with clues on the board instead of numbers — Sweeplings is for you.

apps.name: Sweet Glassgirl 2
apps.short_description: Sweet Glassgirl 2 - A simple and beautiful jigsaw puzzle game featuring five pretty and adorable girls wearing glasses. Enjoy wonderful moments with relaxing music. After completing a level, you can admire the girls' photos in the gallery.

apps.name: Swinging Pier Clean Simulator
apps.short_description: Swing between skyscrapers on a co-op cleaning crew's precarious scaffold, blast years of grime away with foam and pressure washers, and try not to send your teammates flying. Solo zen or 4-player chaos — the choice is yours

apps.name: Switch Shapes
apps.short_description: A high-speed reflex game where the music is born from your performance. Alternate forms, survive the chaos, and drive a procedural soundtrack inspired by Brazilian rhythms, electronica, and psychedelia.

apps.name: Swords and Guns
apps.short_description: Swords and Guns is an intense, cooperative, first-person tower defense where modern weapons clash with fantasy hordes as you defend a castle from skeletons, knights, and other monsters.

apps.name: Synthetic Quorum
apps.short_description: A first-person sci-fi social deduction game for up to 8 players. Fix the ship, watch your crewmates, then accuse and vote out the infected. Or be Patient 0: lie, sabotage and vanish. A co-op mode swaps the traitor for a hunter and a ticking clock.

apps.name: Tag!
apps.short_description: TAG! is a fast-paced 2-8 player multiplayer parkour game of tag. Grapple, wall run, slide and outplay friends to avoid being It when the timer hits zero! Customize your look and your unique abilities for the ultimate party game experience.

apps.name: Talystro
apps.short_description: Combine cards, dice, and creative logic to defeat your numerical adversaries! Talystro is a deckbuilder with a mathematical twist, namely you have to match the value of your enemies to destroy them! Build your deck, power up your dice and crush your enemies!

apps.name: TauTau
apps.short_description: The ultimate customizable color-matching party game! Play with up to 10 players or bots, build custom decks, and toggle wild house rules—no card DLCs needed, the content is in your hands! Features online/offline modes, real-time comms, and preset decks in a chaotic take on Crazy Eights.

apps.name: Tending
apps.short_description: Tending is a cozy game about houseplants. Buy plants, figure out where each one likes to live, water them and watch them grow. Take cuttings to grow even more. Nothing dies, so if a plant is struggling, just move it somewhere better.

apps.name: Terrarium Tycoon
apps.short_description: Build a tiny world in a jar. Layer gravel, charcoal, moss and soil, plant ferns and succulents, then add frogs, a box turtle, snails, ladybugs or a few fireflies. Give it its own weather: a little sun, a rain cloud, a thunderstorm, snow. Share it or sell it on the marketplace and become a tycoon!

apps.name: Tessela
apps.short_description: Relax and organize the chaos in Tessela, a 2D pixel art puzzle game designed to play without pressure or clocks. Overcome 99 handcrafted levels featuring colored blocks, different shapes, and challenges meant to clear your mind.

apps.name: That's Exactly What a Wolf Would Say!
apps.short_description: An online social deduction game for up to 10 players. Live the cottage dream by day and survive the wolves by night! You hear howling outside, and the Witch isn't on the line... Coincidence? That's EXACTLY what a wolf would say!

apps.name: The Crooked Table
apps.short_description: Four players. Three secret sides. One table full of liars. Play every card face down, claim whatever you like, and bet your chips that someone else is lying. Help your team, sabotage the table, or play everyone for yourself. Just don’t get caught.

apps.name: The Dark Forest Calls
apps.short_description: The world forgot Psara, but the island did not forget you. In this story-driven first-person survival horror, explore its fog-shrouded shores as Elias Whitmore, evade creatures drawn to light and sound, manage scarce supplies, and uncover why Psara vanished from human memory.

apps.name: The Demon Wins
apps.short_description: Build each mercenary from the ground up in a permadeath dark fantasy auto-battler where there are no classes - only combinations. Find powerful loot, mutate attacks, combine skills, choose paths, and turn what you find into the power to win.

apps.name: The Dictatories
apps.short_description: Experience 50 days in a country slowly falling into chaos. Read newspapers and witness the rise of oppression through the eyes of an ordinary citizen. A first-person atmospheric narrative about silence, propaganda, and the collapse of a society.

apps.name: The Edgelands
apps.short_description: A cyberpunk city builder. Start with a desert wasteland. Build the roads, zone the blocks and turn a stretch of dust into a sprawling megacity of neon and towering Spires. Keep the streets under control, strike deals with megacorps and build your own version of utopia.

apps.name: The First Pixel
apps.short_description: In the beginning there is a white screen and one black pixel. Click it, and it wakes. Grow it into pattern, memory and meaning, hunt 100 lost relics across erased worlds, and discover what a pixel sees once it has gathered everything. A quiet, mysterious incremental.

apps.name: The Fog & Flask
apps.short_description: Run a cozy potion bar on a misty swamp. Pour layered potions that settle by density, grind, chop and heat ingredients, and serve curious guests with secrets of their own. By night, hold back the creeping fog with your lantern and follow the trail of your vanished mentor.

apps.name: The Ghost and The Phoenix
apps.short_description: Peer beyond the veil and experience the ethereal in The Ghost and The Phoenix, a captivating neo-classical top-down shooter. Navigate the realms between life and death in this supernatural action-packed adventure.

apps.name: THE GRAVES VIGIL
apps.short_description: The Graves Vigil is an atmospheric psychological horror game with point-and-click elements. Alone in the Graves estate, you must survive until five in the morning: spot anomalies, guard your sanity, and keep the house from sinking into darkness.

apps.name: The King's Muster
apps.short_description: The King is dead, the Capital sealed. You keep the Muster Roll that still calls men to arms. Draw a line in the dirt and a company falls in on it. Raise a few dozen recruits into a host of a thousand, read the front as it bends, storm their walls and hold yours. A pixel-art real-time wargame.

apps.name: The Legendary Sortsmith
apps.short_description: A legendary gnome blacksmith forges mythic weapons faster than anyone can put them away. You’re his apprentice. Haul, toss and sort 4,000+ swords, axes, hammers and cursed oddities in this first-person tidying game, solo or with up to 3 friends.

apps.name: The OutBreak Protocol
apps.short_description: Escape the outbreak with friends! A survivor horror multiplayer experience that will allow you to fight hordes of zombies, escape unique scenarios and most important of all... Survive the outbreak!

apps.name: The Speedy Moski-Man
apps.short_description: The one and only superhero of the fleur-de-lis people? It's a skiing mosquito! The Speedy Moski-Man is the story of Pablo Picard, a rather intelligent but solitary young student whose life is turned upside down at the beginning of summer vacation.

apps.name: The Zibbo Show
apps.short_description:
Be the star of the most exciting game show on TV! 

Pick your dice, place your bets, build your combos, and try not to think too hard about what happens when you lose.

apps.name: Their Personal Organizer
apps.short_description: Become a professional home organizer and take on assignments for five female clients. Navigate through piles of clothing and personal belongings to devise an efficient sorting strategy, placing items into the appropriate storage containers.

apps.name: There's a Cat in My PC
apps.short_description: A completely free desktop pet with no payments, ever! Allergic to cats? You can still adopt! Meet 98 one-of-a-kind cats that drop by every day, right on top of your PC windows~

apps.name: Those We Serve
apps.short_description:
The king is murdered. You are killed too. But death isn't the end.
Relive the same cursed day in a turn-based RPG where perfectly timed parries, dodges, and your decisions determine whether you survive long enough to uncover the truth.

apps.name: Three Kingdoms: Devour the World
apps.short_description: A pixel-art idle strategy game set in the Three Kingdoms. Recruit 193 generals, build your team, set formations and assign treatises, then watch them fight through 57 campaigns, from the Yellow Turban Rebellion to the rise of Jin, and on into the Immortal Trial and the Demon Realm.

apps.name: Through the Shatter
apps.short_description: Enter the fractured realm of The Shatter, armed with nothing but your wits. Through The Shatter is an exploration roguelike where you navigate a foggy world full of threats, manage resources, bargain with survivors, cultivate artifacts, and face a looming Void to discover the secrets beneath.

apps.name: Tidy Town
apps.short_description: Tidy Town is a third person cleaning game where you combine everyday objects to tidy up messes and transform spaces. Help Percy lend a paw one room at a time as he saves a friend’s cafe, rebuilds a city park, refreshes an artist’s studio and tidies his way across town and into his community's heart.

apps.name: Tidy Up! Uncle Tony's Toy Store
apps.short_description: Tidy a messy toy store by day, then grab your ghost vacuum when midnight strikes! Sort thousands of toys onto the right shelves, vacuum slime, catch cute ghosts and return them to snow globes.

apps.name: Tidyspell
apps.short_description: Tidyspell is a cozy first person magic tidying game. Lift and place every object with your wand, catch invisible thieving spirits, fly on your broom, brew potions and step through doors into rooms that are bigger on the inside.

apps.name: Time Traveler: Divergence
apps.short_description: A systemic medieval RPG where you play a stranded traveler from the future. Rebuild your device, replicate technology, shape a living kingdom through trade, diplomacy or force, and beware: its people — and History itself — will remember what you do.

apps.name: Time Well Spent: Tidy Up the Watch Shop
apps.short_description: An elegant watch shop lies in chaos: over 1,000 watches are scattered across two floors. Read each dial, recognise its brand and its mechanism, and return every piece to its cabinet in this cozy tidy-up game, all while a narrated story about time and life unfolds.

apps.name: Tiny Tycoons
apps.short_description: Build and decorate cozy little businesses for a community of hamsters. Design the layout, choose furniture and style, hire staff to keep things running, and unlock new shop types as you grow.

apps.name: TinyBriks
apps.short_description: TinyBriks is a relaxing minimalist plastic brick building game where there are no objectives, no building instructions, no time pressure and no maximizing shareholder value. Make whatever YOU want. Create fantastic dioramas from a plethora of brick styles and colors. Your imagination is the limit.

apps.name: To Rule... Bavarin
apps.short_description: A deep single-player kingdom management strategy game where you build, govern, and defend a fragile realm. Balance economy, warfare, diplomacy, quests, and exploration as every decision shapes the legacy of your reign.

apps.name: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis
apps.short_description: Experience a stunning reimagining of Lara Croft’s debut adventure to discover the lost secrets of Atlantis with jaw-dropping visuals, modern gameplay, and new surprises that honor the spirit of the original.

apps.name: Tonari Days: Your Desktop Companion
apps.short_description: A desktop companion and study buddy who works right beside you. Tonari runs a Pomodoro focus timer with you, keeps your to-dos and calendar, plays lo-fi music and ambient sounds, and reads your screen aloud. With voice recognition, she also opens apps, sets the volume and more on your PC.

apps.name: Totally Safe Moon Project
apps.short_description: BREAKING NEWS! A giant asteroid is about to wipe out Earth, and your only escape is the Moon! Grab anything you can find, stack it high, and build your way to safety, solo or with up to 3 friends! Think Only Up, but YOU'RE the architect. What could possibly go wrong?

apps.name: Trillionaire Mercenaries of 21XX
apps.short_description: In 21XX, humanity clings to the remains of a cyberpunk world consumed by the ocean. As corporations fight for what's left, you'll work as a mercenary for the ultra-rich, carrying out covert operations in a third-person stealth adventure that tips the balance of global power.

apps.name: Troubleshooting
apps.short_description: chaotic FPS roguelite inside your old family computer! Blast corrupt files, grab XP, stack weird upgrades, and place desktop junk to shape the arena as the system falls apart in increasingly stupid ways.

apps.name: Turf Wars: Slumika
apps.short_description: Build a crew and run the streets of a generated city in the country of Slumíka. Cook and deal, fight rival gangs, dodge police heat, buy houses and stash your goods in this top-down crime sim. Every new game is a new city.

apps.name: Turrákata
apps.short_description: Hustle is an open-world survival-crafting game and top-down shooter set on a tiny planet. You're a dude hunting down the guy who stole your red cap, exposing your ugly, putrid, bald head. Shoot, gather, craft, build, expand your map, dodge bullets and fight bosses to seek revenge.

apps.name: Um Hummels willen
apps.short_description: You are Brumhilde von Hummelbommel. You wake up alone in February: find a hole in the ground, gather pollen and nectar, raise your daughters and build your nest. Nine months against wasps, birds, storms and heat. In November only one thing counts: is your colony still standing?

apps.name: Unabandoned
apps.short_description: An online co-op horror game for 1 to 4 players. Find and destroy cursed objects to weaken the ghost before dispatching it for good. Whether exploring alone or with friends, something menacing could be lurking behind every door you unlock, so remember to bring a flashlight and don’t let it get you.

apps.name: Uncanny Diary
apps.short_description: Uncanny Diary is a narrative-driven investigative dungeon crawler set in a village in Japan. Investigate the disappearance of Ren Akiyama's twin brother by gathering clues during the day, and fight monsters at night to get the help of a mysterious supernatural diary.

apps.name: Under the Aurora
apps.short_description: A mystery quest exploring life, death, and the path to return.

apps.name: Until the Last Machine
apps.short_description: Build a sprawling base, power it with energy and alloy, and send hundreds of mechs, tanks and jets into one massive battle. Hide behind shield domes, research new technology, and when the time comes, launch the nukes. A sci-fi RTS fought until the last machine.

apps.name: Up, Up! Neon Stairs
apps.short_description: Two buttons: climb, or turn and climb. One wrong press and you fall. A neon stair-climbing game of pure focus — rise from the city through the sky and space, all the way to the sun. Play 1v1, 4-player races with items, 2v2 or co-op online, plus a new daily course every day. Free to play.

apps.name: Uphill Both Ways
apps.short_description: Two penguins, one snowball. Balance on top of it together and steer it down a mountain of six wild worlds as it grows, melts and sends you flying. Then ride it all the way back up. A co-op physics comedy for two, online or on one PC.

apps.name: USB Unemployment Speedrun Behavior
apps.short_description: Plug in as many USBs as you can!

apps.name: VALD in EUROPA
apps.short_description: Unite Europe in 50 turns. Over 30 nations and lands, over 100 characters. Actions each turn are limited — what you put off is the strategy. Take a country and judge its queen: execute, recruit, or release. 7 rivals court the princesses you haven't won yet. 4 routes. 1,000+ watercolour-style images.

apps.name: Vampire Must Die: Chain Divine
apps.short_description: Inscribe Sigils and defend the Crystal from vampire hordes in this pixel-art tower defense roguelite. Launch enemies skyward, blast them with Holy Fire Barrels, and smash them into each other for chain reactions. Pick the best upgrades from ever-changing choices, or fight with your own weapons.

apps.name: Vast Mines
apps.short_description: A simple but addictive isometric mining game, get upgrades, forge pickaxes, and travel deeper into the mines.

apps.name: Vehicle Game
apps.short_description: It is a game where you gather resources, secure food, and build structures to survive to the very end.

apps.name: Verdant Requiem
apps.short_description:
“SRPG in Search of Balance"
On a continent where three nations’ ideals clash, what will you choose, and what will you protect? Verdant Requiem is a SRPG about a war for balance beyond good and evil, featuring detailed 2D maps, branching storylines, resource management, and elemental balance.

apps.name: Victor's Video Vault
apps.short_description: It's 1995. The video store is alive. When the last customer leaves, the final rental rewrites reality.

apps.name: VITA: Observa.Momento.Adservo.
apps.short_description: VITA is a third-person exploration game centered on observation, discovery, and the relationship between mother nature and human nature. You play as VITA-UNIT-05, an autonomous Ecological Observation Unit that awakens on an unfamiliar Earth.

apps.name: VOCABLUFF
apps.short_description: VOCABLUFF is an online social deduction game for 3–8 players built around words, bluffing, hidden roles, and voice chat. Read the room, deceive your friends, expose the liar, and jump into fast rounds inside a lively first-person bar.

apps.name: Void Havoc
apps.short_description: In this sci-fi action/strategy game, you're the only trump card left to stop the Contingency in their destructive march. Man your ship, build your arsenal and blow away the waves sent to stop you in your tracks.

apps.name: Volcaldera Ashfall
apps.short_description: James is a human living in a world populated by colorful dinosaur people. The problem is, dinosaurs have teeth. They have claws. They're usually not afraid to use them carelessly. James is the only one that seems to have a problem with this, but he finds himself living in a house with four of them.

apps.name: Vroom Room
apps.short_description: The ultimate cozy idle multiplayer toybox. Collect dozens of toys, watch them drive and stunt around in handcrafted 3D physics-based spaces, then jump in and take the wheel whenever you like. Embrace the joy of discovery as you chill with friends, hunt for secrets and unlock rare toys.

apps.name: Waifu Desire
apps.short_description: Move all parts to form the complete image.

apps.name: Walk-In: Fold It Together
apps.short_description: Three thousand pieces of clothing just hit the floor. Iron out every crease, fold each one by hand, and file it back where it belongs. A cosy first-person tidying game that slowly automates your own ritual. Invite some friends to help, up to 8 players!

apps.name: Walkers
apps.short_description: Walkers is an open-world zombie survival game with advanced base building and NPC systems. Scavenge, craft, and loot across a post-apocalyptic wasteland. Recruit survivors from the streets, assign them as workers, guards, or companions.

apps.name: Wall Brawl
apps.short_description: Hold the line! Team up in this tactical multiplayer castle‑brawler where players raise fortresses, set up defenses, and smash through enemy strongholds with physics‑driven destruction. Heroic last stands! Questionable tactics! Bricks moving at unsafe speeds!

apps.name: Watermellionaire
apps.short_description: Watermellionaire is a dark battle royale fruit-matching game. Pitted against other employees, you compete to become the Most Valuable Packer (MVP) - those who fail are fired. Faced with nothing but a box, some fruit and a guard watching your every move, only one person can come out on top.

apps.name: What Killed Rachel
apps.short_description:
A story-driven psychological horror that chases the truth behind Rachel's death. 
As you follow scattered memories, you slowly come face to face with the reality of the tragedy.
Blaming someone is easy.
But answering what truly killed her is not.

apps.name: Wizalign
apps.short_description: A match-3 adventure RPG where every action happens on the puzzle board. Battle monsters, collect keys, discover powerful dungeon items, manage health and shields, and defeat bosses as you explore overworlds and dungeons inspired by classic adventure games.

apps.name: X-Ninja
apps.short_description: Take control of X and fight your way through 42 VERY challenging levels! Every enemy on the screen must be defeated before you can escape, but the time limits are tight, so don't hang about! If you really want to push it, try grabbing a gem before making your exit

apps.name: Xmas Squad
apps.short_description: Physics co-op comedy for up to 4 players: deliver presents, steal cookies and save your friends from monsters. One more house and we're outta here. Promise.

apps.name: Zephyr's World
apps.short_description: Meet Zephyr, a curious little bird powered by AI running locally on your computer. Leave him notes, explore his town, and watch him discover hobbies, make friends, build games, and create videos. A cozy companion game about a little bird with a life of his own.

apps.name: ZX Allstar Holdem
apps.short_description: 18+ erotic No-Limit Hold'em. Bust the heroines and watch them happily reveal their secret rewards. Sponsor them, unmask the Dealers, collect every story.

apps.name: いつまでも美シク - Villa NEPENTHES -
apps.short_description: 『いつまでも美シク - Villa NEPENTHES -』は、探索するほど老いていく、孤島館ホラーADV。若さを奪う館の真相を暴き、偽装工作で敵を欺き、崩れゆく島から脱出せよ。

apps.name: キメキャワ♥限界ビートちゃん
apps.short_description:
Smash the cute monsters with fun!
This is a rhythm game with easy controls!

apps.name: 它说山雨欲来
apps.short_description:
50+ endings! 
A purely fictional fantasy world!
Comedy script, dark plot — and the endings? Pitch-black.
Swept into a storm, you need a boss. The revolutionary, the merchant, or the cult leader? Your pick unlocks different paths. You're a cheater with buffs — you'll survive. Go!

apps.name: 庭小人の庭
apps.short_description: The Garden of the Garden Gnomes is a deck-building roguelike where you grow plants in your garden and battle with them. Deeply blending deck-building with tactical RPG strategy, plant seeds, cultivate your plants, and fight enemies with the power of the cards you've nurtured.

apps.name: 彈幕憶星環 ~ Danmaku Surround Starry Sky
apps.short_description: 「彈幕憶星環 ~ Danmaku Surround Starry Sky」is a small-scale bullet hell shoot 'em up featuring simplified mechanics.  forming an unnatural starry sky at high altitude that was visible to the naked eye. As a spatial administrator, Mekai sets off to investigate in accordance with her duty,

apps.name: 牛丼店シミュレーター
apps.short_description: Made by someone with nearly 10 years in a gyudon (beef bowl) shop. A first-person shop sim where you wash rice, simmer beef, plate bowls, juggle IH burners and ring up orders like the real job. Run out of rice and the shop closes. Shout through the lunch rush solo or with up to 4 friends online.

apps.name: 红楼梦：林黛玉与北静王
apps.short_description: 在大观园的繁华与幻境之间，跟随失忆的贾宝玉，找回被掩埋的记忆，并在一次次抉择中改写众人的命运。

apps.name: 魏识的夜晚
apps.short_description: Wei Shi becomes your reflection in your senior year. Drifting without a fixed self, they set out into oblivion—or piece together fragments of an unfamiliar youth. With your friends, they tend each other's restless hearts and share what it takes to find happiness.

apps.name: 魔物娘咖啡館
apps.short_description: Monster Girl Cafe is an adult game that blends coffee-making, relationship building, and titillating tales of dating. Meet monster babes, remember their orders, and chat 'em up. Between honing barista skills and falling in love, get ready for busy days of romance and adventure!

apps.name: 黒猫の占星便　Melodiac：Astral Cat Express
apps.short_description:
"I'm a cat. I don't have a form, or promise, yet." 
 Embark on a unique journey of stars, magic and music, starting from your birthday and woven with astrology and zodiac signs.

apps.name: 가문의 영광
apps.short_description: A single-player idle RPG with classic K-MMORPG spirit and no paid gacha. Switch between nostalgic and painted visuals, hunt manually or automatically, and grow through loot, crafting, equipment enhancement, and family progression.

apps.name: Abyss Ring Soundtrack
apps.short_description:
The following 5 tracks are included:
・PV BGM
・Boss Battle BGM 1
・Boss Battle BGM 2
・Opening BGM
・Home BGM

apps.name: Backrooms: Realm of Shadows Soundtracks
apps.short_description: Backrooms: Realm of Shadows Soundtracks contains the memorable music from the game, composed by drveramusic.

apps.name: Curse of Resthaven Soundtrack
apps.short_description: The complete instrumental soundtrack, composed by Scott Christian, composer of Lil’ Guardsman’s award-winning score and game director of both games.

apps.name: Curse of Resthaven – Black Pony Tavern EP
apps.short_description:
Five original songs performed by the in-game Bard at Resthaven’s Black Pony Tavern.

Composed by Scott Christian and co-written with Michael Cox, these songs blend medieval and Renaissance musical traditions with anachronistic influences from East Coast Canadian folk and roots Americana.

apps.name: CyberDeck Soundtrack
apps.short_description: Take the music of CyberDeck with you. Volume 1 includes all 24 in-game tracks, with over 51 minutes of phonk, synthwave and dark electronic music in MP3 format. Includes the vocal title song, cinematic intro and combat music. Contains explicit language.

apps.name: CyberSprawl: Survivors Soundtrack
apps.short_description: Take the music of CyberSprawl: Survivors with you. Volume 1 includes all 31 tracks from the game by CyberPhonkMusic, with more than 96 minutes of music in MP3 format. Download the songs through Steam and listen in your preferred music player.

apps.name: DARKHAND The First Tracks
apps.short_description: Soundtrack to Phase 1 of the free DARKHAND PROLOGUE Chapter.

apps.name: DayOff Soundtrack
apps.short_description: A dark synth-driven soundtrack inspired by 1980s America, small-town mysteries, and the eerie atmosphere of a world on the brink of collapse. Melancholic melodies, retro synthesizers, and haunting rhythms capture the loneliness, danger, and nostalgia of Moonriver.

apps.name: Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School Soundtrack
apps.short_description: Evil genius DJ doseone is back with a sick round of fresh beats to chill and study to. The all-new Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School Official Soundtrack provides the perfect audio background for puzzling. Digital Download included with the Escape Academy 2 Deluxe Edition!

apps.name: FACTORIZE 1 Original Soundtrack
apps.short_description: The original soundtrack to FACTORIZE 1, featuring 35 tracks from throughout the game—from exploration and battles to boss encounters and the ending.

apps.name: God of War Ragnarök Soundtrack
apps.short_description: God of War Ragnarök Soundtrack - Music Composed by Bear McCreary

apps.name: Icewind Dale: Enhanced Edition Official Soundtrack
apps.short_description: Experience the unforgettable original soundtrack for Icewind Dale: Enhanced Edition composed by Jeremy Soule.

apps.name: Lap of the Gods: A Visual Novel - Music From the Game
apps.short_description: The full 63-track OST from Lap of the Gods: A Visual Novel!

apps.name: Mega Man Battle Network Legacy Collection Original Soundtrack
apps.short_description: Mega Man Battle Network Legacy Collection's music gets supercharged with 22 diverse tracks featuring new arrangements of classic Mega Man Battle Network tunes!

apps.name: SteamVR
apps.short_description: Grab SteamVR to access and play VR games using your HTC Vive, Oculus Rift, Windows Mixed Reality headset, or any other supported VR headset and controllers.

apps.name: Mortal Kombat: Legacy: Jax, Sonya and Kano (Part 1)
apps.short_description: In the Black Dragon's warehouse, Kano supervises his cartel as they prepare to ship stolen robotics under the codename "Cyber Initiative" to an undisclosed location.

apps.name: PAYDAY: The Web Series: First World Bank
apps.short_description: The first look into the backstory of the game by Overkill Software, PAYDAY 2!

apps.name: The Making of Grim Fandango Remastered: Developing the Game
apps.short_description: The makers of Grim Fandango discuss the development of the beloved adventure game and how Double Fine Productions plans to release the original classic to a contemporary audience.
